聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(28日)在傑克森霍爾央行年會發表演說，重申2%通膨目標，並表示若物價未能以足夠快的速度回落，Fed就「還有工作要做」。華爾街普遍將談話解讀為偏鷹，但也認為華許刻意保留9月政策空間，既恢復部分抗通膨信譽，又沒有真正承諾升息。全文詳讀

AI大單難解近渴！Marvell暴跌超10% 市值蒸發218億美元

華許想讓市場忽略Fed發言？美債反應卻恰好相反

聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)希望債券投資人根據美國經濟基本面交易，不要隨著央行官員的發言起舞，但市場迄今的表現卻恰好相反。自華許5月上任以來，美債殖利率曲線幅度最大的3次單日波動，全都發生在他公開露面之後。全文詳讀

預測市場看好Anthropic挑戰SpaceX 爭奪2026年最大規模IPO

SpaceX 今年IPO成功集資 857 億美元，幾乎是先前歷史最高紀錄的三倍之多。然而，這座歷史王冠可能很快就會易主。根據預測市場的最新數據，人工智慧(AI)新創公司 Anthropic 有望在今年奪下最大規模 IPO 的頭銜。根據 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等預測平台的交易資料，投資人認為 Anthropic 很有可能超越 SpaceX。全文詳讀
paras_en: Wall Street: Fed’s Warsh says a lot yet says nothing? Fed refuses to give direction, market fears bigger volatility. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the Jackson Hole central bank meeting on Friday (the 28th), reiterating the 2% inflation target and stating that if prices do not fall quickly enough, the Fed “still has work to do.” Wall Street largely read the remarks as hawkish but also believes Warsh is deliberately leaving policy space for September, restoring some anti‑inflation credibility without committing to a rate hike.

Marvell (MRVL-US) saw its stock plunge more than 10% as the market’s appetite for AI deals waned, wiping out $21.8 billion in market value. Although the latest earnings report and revenue outlook were solid, they failed to meet the market’s lofty expectations for the AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will meaningfully contribute to revenue. The stock fell 10.28% on Friday (the 28th) to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market cap and bringing the total down to about $189.96 billion.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) set a 10‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, indicating that concerns about AI software are gradually fading. The stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting the strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings and the improving sentiment toward the software sector as peers and competitors report impressive results.

Warsh wants the market to ignore Fed commentary? Treasury reaction goes the opposite way. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh hopes bond investors will trade based on the fundamentals of the U.S. economy rather than dancing to central‑bank remarks, but market behavior so far has been the reverse. Since Warsh took office in May, the three largest single‑day moves in the Treasury yield curve have all occurred after he appeared publicly.

Forecast markets see Anthropic challenging SpaceX for the largest IPO of 2026. SpaceX’s IPO this year raised $85.7 billion, nearly three times the previous historical high. However, that crown may soon change. According to the latest data from prediction markets, AI startup Anthropic is poised to claim the title of the biggest IPO this year. Trading data from platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket show investors believe Anthropic is very likely to surpass SpaceX.

items.title: 中國駭客攻破Fed、NASA？美司法部緊急修正說法
items.title_en: Chinese Hackers Target Fed, NASA? US Justice Department Quickly Revises Statement
paras: 美國司法部週五 (28日) 修正日前公布的中國駭客案資訊，表示聯準會 (Fed)、美國國家航空暨太空總署 (NASA) 及聯邦參議院等機構，是中國國家支持駭客組織 QTFY 的攻擊目標，但不代表全部都已遭成功入侵。
司法部8月26日發布的新聞稿，原將上述政府機構列為駭客行動的「受害者」；最新版本則改稱這些機構是QTFY的「目標」。司法部解釋，原稿把所有機構都描述為受害者，但政府為查封相關網域提交的宣誓書顯示，所有機構都曾遭鎖定，實際遭入侵的只有部分單位。
這項修正縮小了已確認遭攻破的範圍。美方先前將QTFY描述為一個長期從事網路間諜活動的中國駭客組織，攻擊對象包括美國政府機構、國防承包商及其他敏感單位。
NASA及參議院攻擊未成功
根據聯邦調查局 (FBI) 隨案公布的宣誓書，QTFY至少自2018年起，便鎖定NASA、聯準會、能源部、司法部、衛生與公共服務部、國家衛生研究院 (NIH) 及聯邦參議院等政府網路。
FBI調查發現，駭客曾嘗試利用軟體漏洞入侵NASA，但NASA已完成相關程式修補，因此攻擊並未成功。
FBI、國家安全局 (NSA) 及美國網路司令部網路國家任務部隊另行發布的聯合資安公告顯示，駭客2026年3月也曾試圖進入聯邦參議院及一家美國醫院的網路，同樣未能得逞。
能源部實驗室等單位確認遭入侵
宣誓書同時列出已成功入侵的案例。美方指控，QTFY於2024年9月侵入三座美國能源部國家實驗室、NIH、衛生與公共服務部轄下機構，以及一家美國資安設備製造商，文件並將這些單位列為受害者。
聯合資安公告也指出，駭客2024年5月曾成功從未具名的國防承包商、金融機構及大學竊取資料。
截至週五，FBI及美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局 (CISA) 尚未回覆置評要求。
中國駐美大使館也未立即回應最新修正。針對美方日前公布的指控，中國使館發言人曾表示，美國利用網路安全問題抹黑中國，並反對美方擴大解釋國家安全概念，以此對中國企業採取歧視性限制。
paras_en: The US Department of Justice on Friday (the 28th) revised information it had previously released about a Chinese hacking case, stating that the Federal Reserve (Fed), the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) and the US Senate were among the targets of the China‑state‑backed hacking group QTFY, but this does not mean all of them were successfully breached.

In the press release issued on August 26, the Justice Department originally listed those government agencies as “victims” of the hacking campaign; the updated version now calls them QTFY’s “targets.” The department explained that the original draft described every agency as a victim, but the sworn affidavits submitted to seize the related domains show that while all agencies were locked onto, only some were actually infiltrated.

The amendment narrows the scope of confirmed successful intrusions. The US had previously described QTFY as a long‑standing Chinese hacker group engaged in cyber espionage, whose targets include US government bodies, defense contractors and other sensitive entities.
NASA and Senate attacks failed

According to sworn affidavits released by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) with the case, QTFY has been targeting NASA, the Fed, the Department of Energy, the Justice Department, the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the US Senate since at least 2018.
FBI investigators found that the hackers attempted to exploit software vulnerabilities to breach NASA, but NASA had already patched the relevant code, so the attack was unsuccessful.

Joint cybersecurity alerts issued by the FBI, the National Security Agency (NSA) and the US Cyber Command’s National Mission Force indicate that the hackers also tried to infiltrate the US Senate and a US hospital’s networks in March 2026, again without success.
Energy‑department labs and other units confirmed they were breached

The affidavits also list the cases that were successfully compromised. US officials allege that QTFY infiltrated three Department of Energy national laboratories, NIH, an agency under the Department of Health and Human Services, and a US cybersecurity‑equipment manufacturer in September 2024, naming those entities as victims.
The joint cybersecurity notice further states that in May 2024 the hackers successfully stole data from an unnamed defense contractor, a financial institution and a university.
As of Friday, the FBI and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) have not responded to requests for comment.

The Chinese embassy in the United States has not immediately responded to the latest revision. Regarding the accusations the US released earlier, a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy said the United States is using cybersecurity issues to smear China and opposes Washington’s broadened interpretation of national‑security concepts to impose discriminatory restrictions on Chinese companies.

items.title: 微軟創今年最長連漲紀錄 AI軟體疑慮逐漸消退
items.title_en: Microsoft Sets Record for Longest Winning Streak This Year as AI Software Concerns Fade
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)股價創下10個月來最長連漲紀錄，凸顯隨著軟體產業證明自己並未在AI時代遭到淘汰，投資人對微軟的青睞程度大幅回升。
微軟股價過去一個月上漲30%，除了反映市場對公司7月財報的強勁正面反應，也顯示隨著同業及競爭對手公布亮眼業績，市場對軟體產業的情緒有所改善。
根據道瓊市場數據，微軟股價周五(28日)連續第六個交易日上漲，這段期間累計上漲6.7%，創下2025年10月28日以來最長的連漲紀錄。
D.A. Davidson分析師認為，Anthropic宣布擴大與Salesforce(CRM-US)的合作、並將其命名為「Claudeforce」，也為微軟股價帶來光環效應。
他表示，這項合作讓投資人意識到，「微軟在提供編排與工具框架方面，甚至比Salesforce處於更有利的位置」，這兩者都是將AI模型整合至現有企業技術架構的方式。
Luria在先前一份報告中寫道，「編排層」指的是「協調不同AI模型、部署AI代理及管理工作流程」，而微軟的Copilot AI助理在這方面表現良好。至於「工具框架」，則是指「讓AI模型能夠存取非AI軟體與功能」的過程，使AI代理能夠執行任務。
Luria表示，微軟如今已扭轉了今年稍早困擾其股價的負面論述。公司在最近一次財報中公布Azure雲端運算業務成長加速，並釋放支出可能放緩的訊號，有助於打消市場對其AI布局無法帶來投資報酬的看法。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟近期股價表現受到投資人信心增強的支持，市場越來越相信微軟能夠透過雲端以外的業務實現AI商業化，例如Copilot及GitHub程式碼助理。
他也指出，Google Cloud與亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services)強勁的營收成長，進一步證明企業雲端市場整體需求依然健康。CoreWeave與Nebius等新型雲端服務商公布的業績也傳達了類似訊息。
Lee表示，這些業績都進一步支持了微軟所說的，「客戶對AI與雲端服務的需求持續超過可用容量。」「簡單來說，整個AI基礎設施的需求持續超越可用供給。」
微軟股價周五收漲1.68%，至每股513.53美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Microsoft (MSFT-US) has set a ten‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, highlighting that as the software industry proves it has not been displaced in the AI era, investor favorability toward Microsoft has surged.

Microsoft’s stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting not only the market’s strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings but also an improvement in sentiment toward the software sector as peers and rivals report impressive results.

According to Dow Jones market data, Microsoft’s share price rose for the sixth consecutive trading day on Friday the 28th, gaining a cumulative 6.7% during that stretch, the longest winning streak since October 28, 2025.
D.A. Davidson analyst notes that Anthropic’s announcement of an expanded partnership with Salesforce (CRM‑US), branded “Claudeforce,” also adds a halo effect to Microsoft’s stock.

He said the collaboration makes investors realize that “Microsoft is in an even more advantageous position than Salesforce when it comes to providing orchestration and tooling frameworks,” both of which are ways to integrate AI models into existing enterprise technology stacks.

Luria previously wrote that the “orchestration layer” refers to “coordinating different AI models, deploying AI agents, and managing workflows,” and Microsoft’s Copilot AI assistant performs well in this area. The “tooling framework” refers to “enabling AI models to access non‑AI software and functions,” allowing AI agents to execute tasks.

Luria added that Microsoft has now turned around the negative narrative that weighed on its stock earlier this year. In its latest earnings report, the company disclosed accelerated growth in its Azure cloud business and signaled that spending may be slowing, helping to dispel market doubts that its AI strategy cannot deliver returns.

StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft’s recent stock performance is supported by growing investor confidence, as the market increasingly believes Microsoft can commercialize AI beyond the cloud, such as through Copilot and the GitHub code assistant.

He also pointed out that strong revenue growth at Google Cloud and Amazon Web Services further proves that overall demand in the enterprise cloud market remains healthy. Results from newer cloud providers like CoreWeave and Nebius convey a similar message.

Lee said these results further back Microsoft’s claim that “customer demand for AI and cloud services continues to exceed available capacity.” In simple terms, “the overall demand for AI infrastructure keeps outpacing supply.”
Microsoft’s stock closed Friday up 1.68% at $513.53 per share.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉金價挫跌3%周線收黑 華許演說後Fed 9月升息機率達五五波
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Gold Falls 3% Weekly, Closes Negative; After Warsh’s Remarks Fed September Rate‑Hike Odds Reach 55‑45
paras: 金價周五(28日)挫跌3%，聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)表示將抑制通膨壓力之後，交易員押注Fed升息機率升高，導致不孳息的黃金受打壓。

黃金現貨下跌2.9%，報每盎司4567.23美元，是8月20日以來最低。


12月交割的黃金期貨收低2.9%，報每盎司4529.90美元。
黃金本周共下跌2.9%，儘管本周二曾一度漲到1696.18美元，觸及三個月高點。
獨立分析師Tai Wong說：「黃金遭到重擊，因為華許確認通膨並未出現實質性放緩，而且Fed『還有工作要做』。雖然這可能再次印證『大聲說話、手持短棒』的策略，但市場將因此把9月會議視為一場五五波的賭局。」
華許表示，如果決策官員無法確信潛在通膨正朝2%的目標回落，Fed「還有工作要做」。在此之前，華許很少如此明確承認，可能需要升息以緩解物價壓力。
在他發表上述談話後，交易員加碼押注Fed 9月升息。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場目前預期Fed 9月升息的機率為58%，高於華許發表談話前的36%；12月升息的機率則達89%。
在高利率環境下，黃金通常吸引力降低，因為黃金本身不會產生收益。
美元升至逾一周高點，使以美元計價的黃金對其他貨幣持有者而言更加昂貴。
印度本周黃金出現大幅折價，因市場傳出印度政府可能考慮撤回近期調高的進口關稅，導致需求大幅下滑。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌3.5%，報每盎司66.81美元。
現貨白金下跌0.6%，報每盎司1835.07美元。
現貨鈀金大漲5.3%，報每盎司1422.25美元。
paras_en: Gold fell 3% on Friday (the 28th) after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said that inflation pressures would be curbed, prompting traders to bet on a higher probability of a Fed rate hike and suppressing non‑yielding gold.
Spot gold dropped 2.9% to $4,567.23 per ounce, its lowest level since August 20. December gold futures fell 2.9% to $4,529.90 per ounce.
Gold fell a total 2.9% this week, even though on Tuesday it briefly rose to $1,696.18, reaching a three‑month high.

Independent analyst Tai Wong said: “Gold took a heavy hit because Warsh confirmed inflation has not shown a substantive slowdown and the Fed ‘still has work to do.’ Although this may again validate the ‘talk loudly, hold a short stick’ strategy, the market will treat the September meeting as a 55‑45 gamble.”

Warsh stated that if policymakers are not convinced that underlying inflation is moving back toward the 2% target, the Fed ‘still has work to do.’ Until now he had rarely been so explicit about possibly needing to raise rates to ease price pressure.
After his remarks, traders increased bets on a September Fed rate hike.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees a 58% probability of a September hike, up from 36% before Warsh’s comments; the odds of a December hike are 89%.
In a high‑interest‑rate environment gold’s appeal usually wanes because it yields no income.
The dollar rose to a more‑than‑week‑high, making dollar‑denominated gold more expensive for holders of other currencies.
India saw a sharp discount on gold this week as rumors that the government might roll back the recently raised import tariff dampened demand.
Other precious‑metal trading: Spot silver down 3.5% at $66.81 per ounce; spot platinum down 0.6% at $1,835.07 per ounce; spot palladium surged 5.3% to $1,422.25 per ounce.

items.title: 伊朗最高領袖聲明：擴大國內生產 降低對美元依賴
items.title_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Declares: Expand Domestic Production and Reduce Dollar Dependence
paras: 伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 週五 (28 日) 呼籲政府擴大國內生產，逐步降低美元在經濟中的重要性，並將「抵抗經濟」政策列為施政核心，以因應通膨、失業與物價管理等相互交織的經濟問題。
穆吉塔巴在伊朗「政府週」發表書面聲明指出，解決當前經濟困境的關鍵，在於進一步依靠國內生產。政府除了推動經濟成長，也應擴大投資，並將資金導向有用且必要的產業，以帶動生產活動。
這項聲明發布之際，伊朗里亞爾本週在自由市場跌破 1 美元兌 200 萬里亞爾，創下歷史新低。美國近期再度加強制裁，進一步對伊朗經濟形成壓力。
穆吉塔巴表示，確保民生必需品與專業性商品供應仍有其必要；若國內產能不足，政府可以進口補充，但必須採取適當且審慎的方式。他認為，鼓勵國內生產並妥善管理進口、物價與商品服務市場，有助逐步改善伊朗經濟中的問題。
他同時要求政府加快採用伊朗年輕菁英提出的技術與創新成果，將其運用於農業、工業、通訊及教育等領域。透過改善管理、擴大專業人士與科技人才參與，以及開發新的產業潛力，可望推動伊朗經濟進一步成長與發展。
穆吉塔巴也肯定政府在戰爭期間維持民生物資與基本服務供應、修復重要受損設施及管理能源供應的表現。伊朗目前面臨制裁與封鎖加劇，使國內物流與物資調度更加困難。
國際油價週五 (28 日) 震盪收低，單週跌幅明顯，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 釋出偏鷹訊號，加上市場期待伊朗與斡旋方就恢復荷姆茲海峽通航取得進展，促使中東戰事推升的地緣政治風險溢價持續回落。
穆吉塔巴迄今尚未公開露面
伊朗前最高領袖哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 6 個月前在美國與以色列空襲中喪生，其子穆吉塔巴受傷後接任至今，卻從未公開露面或親自發聲，引發外界對其健康狀況及伊朗是否存在權力真空的疑慮。
伊朗官員及高階消息人士表示，穆吉塔巴仍在養傷，並因擔心遭刺殺而轉居幕後，但仍定期會見政府高層、接收重要報告，並對重大國家議題作出最終決定，日常權力則交由少數核心人士處理。
不過，他不僅缺席父親 7 月的葬禮活動，至今也沒有發布任何照片、影片或音訊，僅透過主播宣讀少數書面聲明。
穆吉塔巴長期隱身已動搖民眾信心。
華府中東研究所研究員Alex Vatanka 指出，問題已從他是否仍然在世，轉變為伊朗是否還有一位實際運作的最高領袖；就連支持政權的強硬派人士也要求看到他仍在領導國家的證明，反對派與改革派則進一步質疑，他是否仍活著並參與決策。
paras_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Friday (the 28th) called on the government to expand domestic production, gradually reduce the dollar's importance in the economy, and make the "resistance economy" policy a core of governance to address intertwined issues of inflation, unemployment and price management.

In a written statement released during Iran's "Government Week," Mojtaba said the key to solving the current economic hardship lies in further relying on domestic production. In addition to promoting economic growth, the government should expand investment and channel funds toward useful and necessary industries to spur production activity.

The statement comes as the Iranian rial fell below 2 million rials per US dollar in the free market this week, hitting a historic low. Recent U.S. sanctions have intensified pressure on Iran's economy.

Mojtaba stressed that ensuring the supply of essential consumer goods and specialized products remains necessary; if domestic capacity falls short, the government may import to fill gaps, but must do so in an appropriate and prudent manner. He believes encouraging domestic output while carefully managing imports, prices and the goods‑services market will gradually improve Iran's economic problems.

He also urged the government to accelerate the adoption of technologies and innovations proposed by Iran's young elite, applying them to agriculture, industry, communications and education. By improving management, expanding the participation of professionals and tech talent, and developing new industrial potential, Iran’s economy can achieve further growth and development.

Mojtaba praised the government's performance during the war in maintaining the supply of civilian goods and basic services, repairing severely damaged infrastructure, and managing energy supplies. Iran now faces heightened sanctions and blockades, making domestic logistics and material coordination increasingly difficult.

International oil prices slipped lower on Friday (the 28th), with a noticeable weekly decline. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled a more hawkish stance, and markets are hopeful of progress between Iran and mediators on reopening the Hormuz Strait, causing the geopolitical risk premium from the Middle‑East conflict to continue receding.
Mojtaba has not yet appeared publicly.

Six months ago, Iran's former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed in U.S. and Israeli airstrikes; his son Mojtaba, injured in the attack, succeeded him but has never made a public appearance or spoken in person, raising external doubts about his health and whether a power vacuum exists in Iran.

Iranian officials and senior sources say Mojtaba is still recuperating and, fearing assassination, has moved behind the scenes, yet he regularly meets senior government officials, receives key reports, and makes final decisions on major national issues, while day‑to‑day authority is handled by a small core group.
However, he missed his father's July funeral ceremonies and to date has not released any photos, video or audio, communicating only through a few written statements read by broadcasters.
Mojtaba's long‑term invisibility has eroded public confidence.

Alex Vatanka, a researcher at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, noted that the question has shifted from whether he is still alive to whether Iran still has a functioning supreme leader; even hard‑line supporters of the regime demand proof that he is still leading the country, while opposition and reformists further question whether he is alive and participating in decision‑making.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強本周漲約1% 華許演講提高9月升息預期
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 28th) to near a two‑week high after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first thematic speech at the Jackson Hole conference, leading the market to view his stance as hawkish. Warsh said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved," prompting traders to raise expectations for a September Fed rate hike.
The dollar gained roughly 1% this week, recouping the entire loss it suffered last week when a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries triggered a so‑called "currency‑devaluation trade."
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.5% to 99.65, its highest level since August 18.

The highly anticipated Jackson Hole annual economic policy symposium speech by the Fed chair covered topics ranging from artificial intelligence (AI) and forward guidance to the current economic situation. Notably, he said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved" and reiterated that the Fed must keep price stability as its policy priority.

Warsh’s speech came as the Fed was navigating a complex environment. Recent inflation data remained elevated, oil prices were pushed higher by the seemingly endless U.S.–Iran conflict, and a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report deepened divisions within the Federal Open Market Committee, with three regional Fed presidents opposing the July decision to keep rates unchanged.
In his prepared remarks, Warsh said, "As of now, I believe the labor market is at a level of full employment. But with respect to our price‑stability mandate, the current data are more concerning."

The market interpreted the speech as hawkish, and traders lifted their expectations for a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑bp hike in September is now above 57%, up from roughly 35% the day before.

Deutsche Bank analyst Matthew Luzzetti and his team said, "Chair Warsh’s speech surprised us both in the concreteness of his economic outlook and his clearly hawkish tone. After his remarks we think the pressure for a 25‑bp hike in September now rests on the data, unless upcoming releases come in far below expectations. Conversely, we still expect the Fed to raise rates by 50 bps this year, with hikes at the September and December meetings."
Currency‑devaluation trades receded and the dollar recovered.
After Warsh’s speech, U.S. Treasury yields turned higher and bonds were sold off. The 10‑year yield rose 5.9 bp to 4.729%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12 bp to 4.352%.

Bond markets have been extremely volatile lately; long‑dated Treasuries have been sold off amid inflation concerns, a large volume of corporate issuance, and the continued expansion of U.S. sovereign debt.
The U.S. Treasury’s unexpected intervention last week had limited effect in curbing the rise in yields.

Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike by raising borrowing costs for consumers and firms, which usually supports a stronger dollar. However, news that U.S. sovereign debt surpassed $40 trillion last week sparked concerns about fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies—a strategy known as a "currency‑devaluation trade."
In fact, the dollar index fell almost 1% last week while gold and cryptocurrencies rose. Both assets continued to climb this week, but their gains were modest compared with the dollar’s strength.
The Canadian dollar was hit hard by the trade dispute and fell sharply this week.
Among other major currencies, the Canadian dollar drew attention from FX traders as the trade war between Washington and Ottawa heated up, leading the loonie to drop 1%.

After negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down over the weekend, both sides imposed retaliatory tariffs on each other. U.S. President Trump pushed on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

Canadian government data released on Friday showed the economy rebounded strongly in the second quarter, growing 3.3% year‑over‑year, well above the revised 0.3% gain in the first quarter. The growth matched economists’ forecasts but far exceeded the Bank of Canada’s roughly 2.5% projection.
The yen touched 160 for the first time since the historic intervention.

Following Warsh’s hawkish speech, the yen came under pressure on Friday. USD/JPY reached 160, the first time it has hit that level since the historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. The 160 mark has previously been a trigger for intervention.

Conversely, the Korean won strengthened against the dollar for the second consecutive trading day, with USD/KRW falling about 0.5% this week. After investors digested the Bank of Korea’s decision on Thursday to raise rates for the second consecutive meeting, the won rallied and borrowing costs rose to an 18‑month high.

items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Fed Rate‑Hike Signal and Houthi‑Resumption Rumors Push Brent Down Over 5% on Weekly Chart, WTI Falls Over 4%
paras: 國際油價周五(28日)震盪收低，並寫下單周明顯跌幅。市場一方面消化聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)釋出的偏鷹派政策訊號，另一方面押注伊朗與調停方可能就恢復荷姆茲海峽航運取得進展，使先前因中東戰事累積的地緣政治風險溢價進一步消退。
布蘭特(Brent)原油10月期貨收跌39美分或0.43%，報每桶89.31美元；西德州中質原油(WTI)10月期貨收跌13美分或0.16%，報每桶83.40美元。以全周表現計算，布蘭特原油下跌逾5%，WTI跌逾4%，均反映市場對荷姆茲海峽石油供應逐步恢復的預期升溫。
油市周五原本仍受到俄烏戰爭升級、烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯煉油設施等因素支撐，但華許在傑克森霍爾央行年會發表談話後，市場對美國貨幣政策的預期迅速轉趨鷹派。華許表示，若通膨持續高於目標，聯準會可能仍須進一步升息以恢復物價穩定，帶動美元及美國短天期公債殖利率上升，也對包括原油在內的風險資產形成壓力。
Price Futures Group資深市場分析師Phil Flynn表示，全球成品油市場基本面仍然偏強，尤其烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，可能進一步干擾俄羅斯燃料供應。不過，市場同時傳出荷姆茲海峽可能在周末達成重啟航運協議的消息，這成為壓低油價的重要因素。
Rystad Energy分析師Janiv Shah則指出，市場先前低估了實際能夠通過荷姆茲海峽的新增貨運量。伊朗與阿曼規畫的航運走廊，以及美國宣稱持續進行海上掃雷作業，都讓市場預期更多能源貨物可逐步離開波斯灣。他認為，本周油價走低主要反映可通過海峽的實際供應量增加，以及航運流量逐步回升，讓亞洲煉油商得以重新拉貨並消化庫存。
美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事周五已滿6個月。荷姆茲海峽在戰爭爆發前承擔約20%的全球石油供應運輸，因此其航運能否恢復正常，持續左右全球能源市場。近期原油與其他商品船隻雖出現逐步恢復跡象，但流量仍高度不穩定。
最新初步船運數據顯示，周四僅有7艘商品船通過荷姆茲海峽，低於前一天的17艘，也低於過去10天每日平均15艘的水準。市場認為，這顯示海峽航運雖未完全停擺，但距離戰前的正常狀態仍有相當大差距。
與此同時，另一個重要航運瓶頸曼德海峽(Bab el-Mandeb)當天則有17艘商品船通過，其中6艘進入、11艘離開。兩大海上能源運輸要道的船舶流量變化，使全球原油與成品油供應鏈持續面臨高度不確定性。
高盛周四估計，目前波斯灣地區原油總出口量約為每日1500萬至1600萬桶，仍比戰前低約700萬至800萬桶，但已較3月低點增加約500萬至600萬桶。這顯示中東產油國與航運業者正在逐步適應戰爭環境，部分出口能力已透過有限的航運恢復與替代物流管道回到市場。
PVM Oil Futures分析師John Evans指出，未來油市走勢與伊朗戰事高度綁定，荷姆茲海峽局勢不僅影響實際供應，也可能牽動石油輸出國組織(OPEC)內部成員關係、中國能源需求，以及全球煉油系統能否恢復正常運作。
為促成海峽重新開放，調停行動正持續加速。卡達總理兼外交大臣穆罕默德(Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani)日前前往德黑蘭，敦促伊朗尊重國際航道的航行自由。伊朗則同意擬定恢復正常船運的條件清單。伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊(Abbas Araqchi)形容與卡達方面的會談具有「創意」，但同時要求華府停止對伊朗施加軍事與經濟壓力，重返談判軌道。
美國本周宣布對伊朗實施華府所稱「史上最嚴厲」的新一輪制裁，德黑蘭則譴責這些措施是「不人道且充滿敵意的行動」，並表示制裁已逐漸失去效果。美伊雙方目前仍缺乏直接談判，荷姆茲海峽能否真正恢復全面通航，仍高度依賴卡達、阿曼等第三方調停。
另一方面，華府也正尋求從南美洲增加長期原油供應。知情人士表示，川普政府官員正在研議一項協議，爭取長期取得委內瑞拉部分原油儲量的開發與供應權，最終可能讓美國取得更穩定且成本較低的原油來源。報導指出，討論中的模式可能涉及讓美國企業開發特定油田，並確保產出的原油優先供應美國。
據報，委內瑞拉目前每日原油產量約125萬桶，擁有全球最大的已探明原油儲量。川普政府若成功取得部分油田的長期開發權，除了有助於增加美國煉油業的重質原油供應，也可能降低美國對其他地區進口原油的成本。委內瑞拉同時正評估退出石油輸出國組織(OPEC)，若成真，將是這個創始會員國自1960年參與OPEC以來最重大的政策轉變之一。
俄烏戰事則持續為油市帶來另一層供應風險。俄羅斯此前警告，若烏克蘭使用英國提供的長程巡弋飛彈攻擊俄羅斯領土，莫斯科可能打擊烏克蘭境內外的英國軍事目標。另一方面，烏克蘭軍方表示，已對俄羅斯雅羅斯拉夫爾地區的煉油廠發動攻擊，延續近期針對俄羅斯能源基礎設施的打擊行動。
整體而言，油市目前正處於兩股力量拉鋸的局面。一方面，俄羅斯煉油設施受攻擊、中東戰事尚未結束，以及荷姆茲海峽實際船運量仍遠低於正常水準，持續支撐油價；另一方面，更多原油正逐步通過海峽、調停行動持續推進，加上波斯灣出口量已較3月低點明顯回升，則促使市場撤出部分地緣政治風險溢價。
隨著荷姆茲海峽重啟談判進入關鍵階段，市場下一步將密切觀察伊朗提出的條件、美國是否願意透過第三方重啟外交接觸，以及實際船舶流量能否持續增加。在供應恢復速度、俄烏能源戰與聯準會可能轉向升息等多重因素交織下，國際油價短期內仍可能維持劇烈震盪。
paras_en: International oil prices slipped on Friday (the 28th) and posted a clear weekly decline. The market was digesting a hawkish policy signal from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh while also betting that Iran and the mediators might make progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, further eroding the geopolitical risk premium that had built up from the Middle‑East war.

Brent crude October futures fell 39 cents, or 0.43%, to $89.31 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) October futures dropped 13 cents, or 0.16%, to $83.40 a barrel. Over the full week, Brent fell more than 5% and WTI more than 4%, reflecting growing market expectations that oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz will gradually resume.

The oil market on Friday was still being supported by factors such as the escalation of the Russia‑Ukraine war and Ukraine’s continued attacks on Russian refining facilities, but after Warsh’s remarks at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium, expectations for U.S. monetary policy quickly turned more hawkish. Warsh said that if inflation stays above target, the Fed may need to raise rates further to restore price stability, which would lift the dollar and short‑term U.S. Treasury yields and put pressure on risk assets including crude.

Phil Flynn, a senior market analyst at Price Futures Group, said the fundamentals of the global refined‑oil market remain relatively strong, especially as Ukraine’s ongoing attacks on Russian refineries could further disrupt Russian fuel supplies. However, news that a reopening agreement for the Strait of Hormuz might be reached over the weekend has become a key factor pushing oil prices lower.

Rystad Energy analyst Janiv Shah noted that the market had previously underestimated the actual additional cargo volume that could pass through the Strait of Hormuz. The Iran‑Oman shipping corridor and the United States’ continued maritime de‑mining operations have led the market to expect more energy cargoes to gradually leave the Persian Gulf. He believes this week’s price decline mainly reflects the increase in real supply that can traverse the strait and the gradual rebound in shipping flows, allowing Asian refiners to reload and work down inventories.

The United States and Israel have now been at war with Iran for six months as of Friday. Before the war, the Strait of Hormuz handled about 20% of global oil transport, so whether its shipping returns to normal continues to shape the global energy market. Recent signs of a gradual recovery in crude‑carrier and other commodity vessels have emerged, but flows remain highly volatile.

Preliminary shipping data showed that only seven commodity vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, down from 17 the day before and well below the ten‑day average of 15 per day. The market sees this as evidence that while the strait’s shipping has not completely halted, it is still far from pre‑war normal levels.

At the same time, the other major chokepoint, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, saw 17 commodity vessels on the same day, with six entering and 11 exiting. Changes in vessel traffic on these two key maritime oil routes keep the global crude and refined‑oil supply chain under high uncertainty.

Goldman Sachs estimated on Thursday that total crude oil exports from the Persian Gulf region are now about 15‑16 million barrels per day, still roughly 7‑8 million barrels below pre‑war levels but up by about 5‑6 million barrels from the March low. This suggests that oil‑producing countries in the Middle East and shipping firms are gradually adapting to the war environment, with some export capacity returning to market via limited shipping and alternative logistics channels.

PVM Oil Futures analyst John Evans warned that future oil‑market dynamics are tightly linked to the Iran conflict; the situation in the Strait of Hormuz not only affects actual supply but could also influence OPEC member relations, Chinese energy demand, and whether the global refining system can return to normal operation.

To push for the strait’s reopening, mediation efforts are accelerating. Qatar’s prime minister and foreign minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani recently visited Tehran to urge Iran to respect the freedom of navigation in international waterways. Iran agreed to draft a list of conditions for resuming normal shipping. Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araqchi described the talks with Qatar as “creative,” while also demanding that Washington halt military and economic pressure on Iran and return to negotiations.

The United States announced this week a new round of sanctions it called the “toughest ever” on Iran. Tehran condemned the measures as “inhumane and hostile,” saying the sanctions are losing effectiveness. Direct U.S.–Iran talks remain absent, and the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz still heavily depends on third‑party mediation by Qatar, Oman and others.

Meanwhile, Washington is also seeking to increase long‑term crude supplies from South America. Sources familiar with the matter said Trump‑era officials are drafting an agreement to secure long‑term rights to develop and supply a portion of Venezuela’s oil reserves, potentially giving the United States a more stable and lower‑cost crude source. The proposal could allow U.S. firms to develop specific fields and prioritize the output for U.S. consumption.

Venezuela is reported to produce about 1.25 million barrels of crude per day and holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves. If the Trump administration succeeds in obtaining long‑term development rights to some fields, it would boost heavy‑crude supplies for U.S. refineries and could lower the cost of imported oil from other regions. Venezuela is also weighing an exit from OPEC, which would be the most significant policy shift for the founding member since it joined the organization in 1960.

The Russia‑Ukraine war continues to add another layer of supply risk to the oil market. Russia has warned that if Ukraine uses British‑supplied long‑range cruise missiles to strike Russian territory, Moscow may target British military assets inside and outside Ukraine. Ukraine’s military says it has attacked a refinery in Russia’s Yaroslavl region, continuing recent strikes on Russian energy infrastructure.

Overall, the oil market is caught in a tug‑of‑war between two forces. On one side, attacks on Russian refineries, the ongoing Middle‑East conflict and the still‑low actual vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz keep prices supported; on the other, more crude is gradually moving through the strait, mediation is progressing, and Persian‑Gulf export volumes have risen markedly from the March low, prompting the market to shed some geopolitical risk premium.

As negotiations on reopening the Strait of Hormuz enter a critical phase, the market will watch closely Iran’s proposed conditions, whether the United States is willing to re‑engage diplomatically through third parties, and if actual vessel flows continue to rise. With supply recovery speed, the Russia‑Ukraine energy war and a possible Fed rate‑hike shift all interacting, international oil prices are likely to remain highly volatile in the short term.

items.title: AI大單難解近渴！Marvell暴跌超10% 市值蒸發218億美元
items.title_en: AI Orders Remain Elusive as Marvell Crashes Over 10%, Wiping Out $21.8 Billion in Market Value
paras: Marvell (MRVL-US) 最新財報與營收展望雖然表現穩健，仍未能滿足市場對 AI 業務的高度期待。投資人尤其關注與 Google (GOOGL-US) 合作的客製化晶片業務，何時才能對營收帶來顯著貢獻，拖累 Marvell 週五 (28日) 暴跌 10.28%，收在 216.62 美元，單日市值蒸發約 217.8 億美元，降至約 1,899.6 億美元。
隨著大型科技公司競相採用客製化晶片，以降低成本並提升效能，Marvell 成為 AI 投資熱潮的主要受惠者之一，今年以來股價一度接近上漲兩倍。
然而，在大型科技公司今年 AI 支出可望突破 7,400 億美元之際，市場對相關晶片業者的業績期待也水漲船高，穩健的財報與財測已不足以支撐股價。
Marvell 雖然上調 2027 與 2028 會計年度營收預測，市場焦點卻集中在新公布的 Google 客製化晶片合作案。這項交易截至 2033 會計年度可能帶來最高 1,200 億美元營收，但投資人仍無法確定相關業務何時開始大幅挹注營收。
執行長 Matt Murphy 表示，公司截至 2028 會計年度的客製化晶片營收目標，已納入部分 Google 業務貢獻，但相關收入要到 2029 會計年度才會變得更具規模。
在資料中心業務成長帶動下，Marvell 預估 2027 會計年度營收將成長約 45%，2028 會計年度則可望達到約 180 億美元。
摩根士丹利分析師指出，市場原本抱持更高期待，主要就是受到 Google 合作案激勵；然而，這項交易的部分營收貢獻，大致已反映在公司先前提出的財測中，因此未能帶來更多新的上行空間。
Melius Research 認為，儘管上季業績與近期財測相較市場預期不算特別亮眼，但 Google 合作案、與微軟的潛在商機，以及 AI 連接業務的成長空間，仍可能推動公司在 2020 年代結束前具備每股盈餘 20 美元的獲利能力。
華爾街對 Marvell 的長期前景仍抱持期待。財報公布後，至少八家券商上調目標價。
LSEG 彙整數據顯示，分析師目標價中位數為 275 美元，較週五收盤價仍有約 27% 上漲空間。
不過，Marvell 目前本益比約為 74.2 倍，反映市場已提前計入相當程度的成長預期，也意味著公司必須交出更強勁的業績，才能支撐目前的高估值。
paras_en: Marvell (MRVL-US) posted solid earnings and revenue outlook, but it still fell short of the market’s lofty expectations for its AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will start contributing meaningfully to revenue, dragging Marvell’s shares down 10.28% on Friday the 28th to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market value and leaving the company worth about $189.96 billion.

As big‑tech firms race to adopt custom chips to cut costs and boost performance, Marvell has become one of the primary beneficiaries of the AI investment boom, with its stock having nearly doubled at one point this year.

However, with large‑tech AI spending expected to exceed $740 billion this year, expectations for chip makers have risen sharply, and even solid earnings and guidance are no longer enough to sustain the share price.

Although Marvell raised its revenue forecasts for fiscal 2027 and 2028, market attention is centered on the newly announced Google custom‑chip deal. The transaction could generate up to $120 billion in revenue through fiscal 2033, but investors still cannot tell when the business will begin to feed revenue in a material way.
CEO Matt Murphy said the company’s custom‑chip revenue target for fiscal 2028 already includes some contribution from Google, but that related income won’t become sizable until fiscal 2029.
Driven by growth in its data‑center business, Marvell expects fiscal 2027 revenue to grow about 45% and fiscal 2028 revenue to reach roughly $18 billion.

Morgan Stanley analysts noted that the market originally had higher hopes, largely spurred by the Google partnership; however, the portion of revenue from that deal is already largely reflected in the company’s prior guidance, leaving little new upside.

Melius Research believes that despite last quarter’s results and recent guidance not being especially dazzling relative to market expectations, the Google deal, potential opportunities with Microsoft, and growth in AI‑connectivity services could still enable the company to achieve $20 earnings per share by the end of the 2020s.
Wall Street remains optimistic about Marvell’s long‑term outlook, with at least eight brokerages raising their price targets after the earnings release.
LSEG data shows the median analyst price target is $275, implying roughly a 27% upside from Friday’s closing price.

Nevertheless, Marvell’s current price‑to‑earnings ratio is about 74.2×, indicating the market has already priced in a substantial amount of growth and that the company must deliver stronger results to justify its lofty valuation.

items.title: 欣興指今遭檢調調查對財務及業務並沒有重大影響 外資砸42.77億元大買
items.title_en: Xinxing says today's investigation by prosecutors has no material impact on its finances or operations; foreign investors pour NT$4.277 billion in buying
paras: ABF及PCB廠欣興電子(3037-TW)今(28)日盤中股價以1230元改寫歷史新天價，但終場收黑下跌5.93%或70元，以1100元作收，欣興今天盤後透過重訊證實，遭桃園地檢署以涉及妨害農工商罪進行搜查，全力配合檢調單位調查，並強調公司營運正常，對財務、業務並無重大影響。
今天三大法人由外資砸42.77億元買超欣興3673張，但本土法人則站在賣方，投信賣超13張，自營商賣超519張，三大法人合計買超3141張。
欣興 2026 年第第二季營收 428.9 億元，創新高，毛利率 24.08%，季增 6.84 個百分點 ，年增 11.72 個百分點，2026 年第二季稅後純益 131.15 億元，季增 1.6 倍，年增 441 倍，每股純益 8.45 元。
欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
paras_en: ABF and PCB fab Xinxing Electronics (3037‑TW) saw its intraday price hit a historic high of NT$1,230 today (28th), but closed down 5.93% or NT$70 at NT$1,100. After market, the company confirmed via a major announcement that the Taoyuan District Prosecutors Office conducted a search related to alleged obstruction of agriculture, industry and commerce, and Xinxing is fully cooperating with the investigation. It emphasized that operations remain normal and there is no material impact on its finances or business.

Today the three major institutional investors saw foreign investors net buy 3,673 shares of Xinxing for NT$42.77 billion, while domestic institutions were net sellers: investment trusts sold 13 shares, proprietary traders sold 519 shares, resulting in a combined net purchase of 3,141 shares by the three major groups.

Xinxing’s Q2 2026 revenue reached NT$42.89 billion, a record high, with a gross margin of 24.08%, up 6.84 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 11.72 points year‑over‑year. Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit was NT$13.115 billion, 1.6 times the prior quarter and 441 times the same quarter last year, yielding earnings per share of NT$8.45.

For the first half of 2026, Xinxing reported revenue of NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61%, up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year. H1 after‑tax net profit was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times the prior year, with earnings per share of NT$11.7.

items.title: 鴻海和發新能源專案獲LEED 黃金級認證 建築能源成本省逾50%
items.title_en: Foxconn’s HeFa New Energy Project Earns LEED Gold Certification, Cutting Building Energy Costs by Over 50%
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(28)日宣佈，位於高雄市鴻海電芯研發暨試量產中心內的「和發新能源專案」正式取得LEED BD+C v4黃金級認證，建築整體能源成本相較ASHRAE 90.1基準節省達50%以上，室內用水亦較LEED基準節省40%以上。
和發產業園區的鴻海電芯研發暨試量產中心，主要業務為提供電動巴士、乘用車及儲能電芯等應用所需，產能可以達到1GWh；而「和發新能源專案」為中心內四層辦公建築，總樓地板面積約8,000平方公尺。
不同於單純透過個別設備改善建築效能，「和發新能源專案」從規劃初期即將能源、水資源、基地生態、交通及使用者健康納入整體設計考量，在提升建築環境績效的同時，也兼顧工作環境的健康、舒適與長期營運效率。
在能源使用方面，透過建築與機電系統設計，並充分利用和發園區空間，於廠房屋頂及地面停車棚大面積建置太陽光電系統，整合建築節能與再生能源策略。
經能源模擬評估，整體能源成本相較ASHRAE 90.1建築耗能基準節省超過50%，有效降低建築營運階段的能源需求及環境衝擊；停車空間的太陽光電棚架也讓原有空間進一步具備再生能源生產功能。
此外，採用金級省水器具及定流量節流器，室內節水逾 40%、綠化率達 30%，室內依循 ASHRAE 62.1 標準導入足量新風系統與 MERV 13 高效濾網，搭配 CO₂ 與 IAQ 感測器持續監測，兼顧節能與空氣品質。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (the 28th) that the “HeFa New Energy Project” located within its Kaohsiung Cell R&D and Pilot Production Center has officially received LEED BD+C v4 Gold certification. The building’s overall energy consumption is more than 50% lower than the ASHRAE 90.1 baseline, and indoor water use is also more than 40% lower than the LEED benchmark.

The HeFa Industrial Park’s Foxconn Cell R&D and Pilot Production Center primarily supplies battery cells for electric buses, passenger vehicles and energy‑storage applications, with a capacity of up to 1 GWh. The “HeFa New Energy Project” is a four‑story office building within the center, covering roughly 8,000 square metres of floor area.

Unlike projects that rely solely on individual equipment upgrades, the HeFa New Energy Project incorporated energy, water resources, site ecology, transportation and occupant health into its overall design from the planning stage. This holistic approach improves building environmental performance while also ensuring a healthy, comfortable workplace and long‑term operational efficiency.

In terms of energy use, the building and MEP system design, together with extensive use of the HeFa park’s space, installed large‑scale solar photovoltaic arrays on the factory roof and ground‑level parking canopies, integrating energy‑saving measures with renewable‑energy generation.

Energy‑simulation results show that total energy costs are more than 50% lower than the ASHRAE 90.1 reference building, substantially reducing operational energy demand and environmental impact. The solar canopies over parking areas also add renewable‑energy production capability to existing space.

In addition, gold‑rated water‑saving fixtures and flow‑restrictors achieve over 40% indoor water savings, with a 30% greening ratio. The building follows ASHRAE 62.1 by providing ample fresh‑air ventilation and MERV‑13 high‑efficiency filters, complemented by CO₂ and IAQ sensors for continuous monitoring, balancing energy efficiency with indoor air quality.

items.title: 〈國泰金法說〉AI帶動企金放款強勁 國泰世華銀全年NIM展望樂觀上調
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Earnings Call: AI Fuels Strong Corporate Lending, Cathay United Bank Raises Full-Year NIM Outlook Optimistically
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(28)日舉行 2026 年第二季法說會，國泰世華銀行上半年稅後純益 270 億元創歷年同期新高，ROE 達 16.9%，副總傅伯昇指出，受惠於台灣總體經濟強勁、企業資本支出需求熱絡，企業放款年增 21%，在資金成本控制得宜與外幣放款收益提升帶動下，銀行正式將全年淨利差(NIM)目標上調至 1.63%~1.65%。房貸業務則因應央行政策維持審慎控管，整體信用成本與資產品質保持健全可控。
國泰世華銀行 2026 年上半年展現強勁的營運動能，稅後純益達 270 億元，創下歷年同期新高紀錄，股東權益報酬率(ROE)達 16.9%。銀行獲利大幅躍進主要歸功於放款規模擴大、外幣放款動能強勁、結構優化帶動資金成本降低，以及手續費收入爆發性成長。其中，財富管理手收受惠於資本市場熱絡，共同基金與證券商品手續費呈現 60% 至 74% 的強勁增幅，全年度手續費收入維持雙位數成長目標不變。
放款業務結構方面，國泰金財務長陳晏如指出，受惠於供應鏈重組及企業海外資本支出需求熱絡，國泰世華外幣放款表現極為亮眼，年成長高達 34%(即便排除匯率影響，年增率仍達 26%)；此外，中小企業放款亦維持穩健步調，年成長達 7%。
在淨利差(NIM)與存放利差(Spread)的展望上，國泰世華副總暨私人銀行執行長傅伯昇指出，銀行在資金成本控管上極具優勢，加上外幣放款收益提升，上半年 NIM 已來到 1.61%，最近幾個月持續攀升。

傅伯昇表示， 原先國泰世華對全年 NIM 展望是採取相對比較保守的態度，主因難以預測台美央行的貨幣政策變化，不過，最近一段時間觀察，尤其是荷姆茲海峽相關影響之後，亞洲國家陸續有通膨壓力與升息空間，美國 Fed 也採取相對鷹派立場。在台幣利率走揚、外幣放款動能強勁與資金成本控管良好的情況下，國泰世華已將全年度 NIM 展望上調至 1.63% 到 1.65% 左右的水準，存放利差上揚的走勢同樣非常樂觀。
媒體關注科技業與 AI 產業帶動的資金需求，傅伯昇分析，內部並未將 AI 單獨劃分為特定專案，而是看到台灣總體經濟整體強勁好轉，帶動各行各業強烈的資本支出與營運資金需求。經營團隊預估，雙位數的企業放款成長動能將一路延續至今年下半年乃至明年。
至於不動產市場與房貸政策，國泰世華仍秉持嚴謹審慎的風控態度，傅伯昇表示，央行對不動產市場維持緊縮態度，銀行內部策略趨於保守嚴謹，上半年房貸放款年增率控管在 9.3%。
在風險加權資產資源配置上，銀行將更多資源傾斜至收益與動能更佳的企業金融領域。資產品質方面，上半年淨提存信用成本維持在 24 個基點，主要是隨放款增加依法進行正常提存，逾放與呆帳回收皆維持健康可控狀態。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882-TW) held its Q2 2026 earnings conference today (28th). Cathay United Bank posted a record half-year after‑tax profit of NT$27 billion, its highest ever for the same period, with an ROE of 16.9%. Deputy General Manager Fu Po‑sheng said the strong overall Taiwanese economy and robust corporate capital‑expenditure demand lifted corporate loan growth 21% year‑on‑year. With effective funding‑cost control and higher foreign‑currency loan yields, the bank formally raised its full‑year net interest margin (NIM) target to 1.63%‑1.65%. Mortgage lending is being managed prudently in line with central‑bank policy, keeping overall credit costs and asset quality sound and controllable.

Cathay United Bank demonstrated strong operating momentum in the first half of 2026, delivering an after‑tax profit of NT$27 billion – a new record for the period – and an ROE of 16.9%. The profit surge stemmed mainly from expanded loan volumes, vigorous foreign‑currency loan activity, structural optimisation that lowered funding costs, and explosive growth in fee income. Wealth‑management fees benefited from a lively capital market, with mutual‑fund and securities‑product fees jumping 60% to 74%, and the bank maintains its goal of double‑digit annual fee‑income growth.

Regarding loan‑business structure, CFO Chen Yan‑ru noted that supply‑chain restructuring and strong overseas corporate cap‑ex demand made Cathay United’s foreign‑currency loans shine, posting a 34% year‑over‑year increase (still 26% even after stripping out exchange‑rate effects). Meanwhile, SME loans grew steadily at a 7% annual rate.

On NIM and spread outlook, Deputy General Manager and Private‑Banking CEO Fu Po‑sheng said the bank enjoys a strong advantage in funding‑cost management, and with higher foreign‑currency loan yields the half‑year NIM reached 1.61% and has been climbing in recent months.

Fu Po‑sheng explained that the bank’s original full‑year NIM outlook was relatively conservative because of uncertainty around Taiwan and U.S. central‑bank policy. However, recent observations—especially after the Holm‑z Strait‑related developments—show Asian economies facing inflation pressures and room for rate hikes, while the U.S. Fed has taken a more hawkish stance. With rising TWD rates, strong foreign‑currency loan momentum and good cost control, Cathay United has lifted its full‑year NIM guidance to roughly 1.63%‑1.65%, and the spread outlook is similarly upbeat.

The media has focused on tech and AI‑driven funding demand. Fu Po‑sheng said AI is not treated as a separate project internally; rather, the overall robust Taiwanese economy is spurring strong capital‑expenditure and working‑capital needs across sectors. Management expects double‑digit corporate‑loan growth to continue through the second half of this year and into next year.

Regarding the real‑estate market and mortgage policy, Cathay United remains disciplined in risk control. Fu Po‑sheng noted that the central bank maintains a tightening stance on real estate, and the bank’s internal strategy is conservative, keeping the half‑year mortgage‑loan growth rate at a controlled 9.3% year‑on‑year.

In risk‑weighted‑asset allocation, the bank is shifting more resources toward the higher‑return, higher‑momentum corporate‑finance segment. Asset quality stayed solid, with net provision for credit costs at 24 basis points in the first half, reflecting normal provisioning as loan volumes rose, while overdue and bad‑loan recoveries remained healthy and controllable.

items.title: 成本與CBAM雙重壓力籠罩 華新9月調漲316產品每公噸5000元
items.title_en: Cost and CBAM Dual Pressure Loom Over Hwa Hsin; September 316 Product Price Raised by 5,000 NTD per Ton
paras: 華新(1605-TW)今(28)日開出9月盤價，指出受到原物料價格維持高檔，加上歐盟碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)推動，生產成本持續攀升，因此上調304、304含銅以及316產品，其中316產品調漲最多，每公噸上漲5000元。
華新表示，受地緣政治與印尼限縮鎳礦開採政策影響，不銹鋼主要原料包括鎳、銅、鉬等價格維持高檔，加上隨著歐盟推動CBAM，鋼廠減排壓力加劇，使得整體生產成本持續攀升，因此調整304、304含銅以及316產品。
華新進一步表示，304每公噸調漲3000元，304含銅每公噸調漲4000元，316每公噸調漲5000元。另外，200系及300系則維持平盤。
paras_en: Hwa Hsin (1605‑TW) today (28th) released its September price list, noting that raw‑material prices remain at high levels and that the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is being implemented, causing production costs to keep climbing. As a result, it is raising prices for 304, 304 with copper and 316 products, with the 316 product seeing the largest increase of 5,000 NTD per ton.

Hwa Hsin said that geopolitical tensions and Indonesia’s restrictions on nickel mining have kept the prices of key stainless‑steel raw materials—including nickel, copper and molybdenum—high. Coupled with the EU’s rollout of CBAM, steel mills face heightened emission‑reduction pressure, driving overall production costs higher, prompting adjustments to 304, 304 with copper and 316 products.
Hwa Hsin further stated that the price of 304 will rise by 3,000 NTD per ton, 304 with copper by 4,000 NTD per ton, and 316 by 5,000 NTD per ton. The 200 series and 300 series will remain unchanged.

items.title: 鮮活果汁-KY在Q2賺回逾半個股本  上半年EPS達8.98元
items.title_en: Fresh Juice KY Earns Back Over Half of Its Capital in Q2, H1 EPS Reaches NT$8.98
paras: 鮮活果汁-KY(1256-TW)今(28)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年第二季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元；2026年1-6月稅後賺3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
鮮活果汁-KY2026年第二季營收爲15.06億元，毛利率33.44%，季增3.05個百分點，年增2.89個百分點，單季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元。
鮮活果汁-KY在2026年1-6月營收26.48億元，毛利率32.12%，年增4.27個百分點，稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
鮮活果汁-KY指出，面對新茶飲產業邁入「精細化發展」階段，品牌業者更聚焦產品創新、供應鏈效率與食品安全；鮮活憑藉完整的果汁與果粒產品線，加上深厚的研發與生產優勢，將持續滿足茶飲品牌的升級需求。
展望產業環境，鮮活果汁-KY指出，近期中國各地持續推出暑期出行、文旅活動、體育賽事及消費券等促消費措施，為新茶飲市場營運提供支撐，且中國國務院正式批准擴大消費「十五五」規劃，政策重心由過去的刺激消費進一步轉向提高消費率，透過消費者收入提升、消費環境優化及消費結構升級，推動內需市場持續擴大。對食品飲料產業而言，政策方向將有助於消費需求改善與消費結構升級並行發展。
而隨著中國消費市場逐步回暖，鮮活果汁-KY指出，加上新茶飲產業持續朝健康化、多元化、精細化方向發展，市場對高品質、差異化原料的需求仍具成長空間，公司將持續掌握消費趨勢與客戶需求，深化產品研發及供應鏈整合，並透過產能布局與生產效率提升，強化服務客戶及快速回應市場的能力；同時持續拓展新產品及應用場景，積極把握消費升級與產業結構調整所帶來的市場機會，推動下半年營運延續穩健成長動能。
paras_en: Fresh Juice KY (1256‑TW) announced today (28th) its latest profit figures: Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit was NT$205 million, up 77.39% quarter‑over‑quarter and 68.07% year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$5.74 for the quarter; for the first half of 2026 the after‑tax profit was NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold increase year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$8.98.

In Q2 2026 Fresh Juice KY recorded revenue of NT$1.506 billion, a gross margin of 33.44% – up 3.05 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.89 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax net profit for the quarter was NT$205 million, up 77.39% quarter‑over‑quarter and 68.07% year‑over‑year, resulting in EPS of NT$5.74.

For the January‑June 2026 period Fresh Juice KY generated revenue of NT$2.648 billion, with a gross margin of 32.12%, a year‑over‑year increase of 4.27 percentage points. After‑tax net profit reached NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold rise year‑over‑year, and EPS was NT$8.98.

Fresh Juice KY noted that as the new tea‑drink industry moves into a “refined development” stage, brands are focusing more on product innovation, supply‑chain efficiency and food safety. Leveraging its complete juice and fruit‑piece product lines together with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, Fresh Juice will continue to meet the upgrading needs of tea‑drink brands.

Looking ahead, Fresh Juice KY pointed out that recent summer travel promotions, cultural‑tourism activities, sports events and consumer vouchers across China are supporting the new tea‑drink market. The Chinese State Council has also formally approved an expanded “14th‑15th Five‑Year” consumption plan, shifting policy focus from merely stimulating consumption to raising consumption rates through higher consumer incomes, better consumption environments and upgraded consumption structures, thereby expanding domestic demand. For the food‑beverage sector, this policy direction should help improve consumer demand while upgrading consumption patterns simultaneously.

As China’s consumer market gradually recovers, Fresh Juice KY added that the new tea‑drink industry continues to evolve toward health‑orientation, diversification and refinement, keeping demand for high‑quality, differentiated ingredients on a growth trajectory. The company will keep tracking consumer trends and client needs, deepen product R&D and supply‑chain integration, and enhance capacity layout and production efficiency to better serve customers and respond quickly to market changes. It will also keep expanding new products and application scenarios, actively seizing market opportunities created by consumption upgrades and industry‑structure adjustments, to sustain robust growth momentum in the second half of the year.

items.title: 信昌電現金減資6% 10/7起暫停交易、19日新股上櫃
items.title_en: Xinchang Electronics to Reduce Capital by 6% in Cash, Trading Halted from Oct 7, New Shares Listed on Oct 19
paras: 被動元件廠信昌電(6173-TW)預計現金減資6%，今(28)日公告換發股票相關日程，舊股票將於 10 月 7 日至 10 月 16 日暫停交易，新股將於 10 月 19 日恢復換發上櫃買賣，現金減資退還股款則預計於 10 月 23 日正式發放。
信昌電為提升股東權益，辦理現金減資退還股本 1.027億元，每仟股換發 940 股、每股將退還股東 0.6 元現金，信昌電原已實收資本額為17.12億元，減資後實收資本額將降至16.09 億元。
信昌電7月營收5.37億元，月增6.6%、年增49.1%，自結稅後純益1.73億元，年增125%，每股純益1.01元；若加計上半年財報，累計前7月營收29.4億元，年增22%，稅後純益約6.84億元，每股純益約3.99元，賺贏去年全年。
信昌電所屬的華科集團董事長焦佑衡日前指出，此波被動元件缺貨狀況跟過去全面缺有點不太一樣，主要是某些特殊的品項蠻缺的，集團也將針對在 AI 相關領域的各式被動元件擴產。
paras_en: Passive component maker Xinchang Electronics (6173‑TW) plans a 6% cash capital reduction and today (28th) announced the schedule for the share exchange. The old shares will be suspended from October 7 to October 16, and the new shares will resume over‑the‑counter trading on October 19. The cash returned from the reduction is expected to be paid on October 23.

To boost shareholders’ equity, Xinchang Electronics will return NT$1.027 billion of capital, exchanging every 1,000 old shares for 940 new shares and refunding NT$0.6 per share in cash. The company’s paid‑in capital was previously NT$17.12 billion and will fall to NT$16.09 billion after the reduction.

In July, Xinchang Electronics reported revenue of NT$5.37 billion, up 6.6% month‑over‑month and 49.1% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$1.73 billion, a 125% annual increase, and earnings of NT$1.01 per share. Including the first half of the year, cumulative revenue through July reached NT$29.4 billion, up 22% YoY, with after‑tax net profit of about NT$6.84 billion and earnings of roughly NT$3.99 per share, surpassing last year’s full‑year results.

Jiao Youheng, chairman of the Huake Group that owns Xinchang Electronics, recently noted that the current shortage of passive components differs from past widespread shortages; the scarcity is mainly in certain specialized items. The group will expand production of various passive components used in AI‑related applications.

items.title: 台灣大「大哥付你分期」延伸至跨境平台 擴大支付版圖
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile Expands "Big Brother Pay You Installments" to Cross‑Border Platforms, Broadening Payment Reach
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(28)日指出，隨著全球先買後付(BNPL)電商交易額持續提高，旗下「大哥付你分期」也擴大平台合作，從momo、91APP等國內電商場景，延伸至國際跨境集運與代購平台Buy&Ship，進一步拓展支付版圖。
台灣大電信金融副總吳建頤指出，BNPL正從單一通路的結帳選項，轉向可跨平台使用的彈性支付工具。2025年「大哥付你分期」交易額年增64%，用戶數也年增超過6成。此次接入Buy&Ship，再將服務從momo、91APP等國內電商延伸至跨境購物。
台灣大表示，「大哥付你分期」此次導入Buy&Ship，讓消費者在跨境集運與代購服務外，增加分期付款選擇，可依自身財務狀況，安排海外購物產生的集中支出。此外，跨境消費的購買動機也正從價格導向，延伸至海外限定商品、稀有珍藏與興趣型商品。
台灣大進一步提到，從大型綜合電商、品牌電商到跨境購物，將持續把BNPL服務嵌入不同購物路徑，讓分期支付不受單一平台限制，擴大消費者可選擇的支付場景。
至於BNPL現況，根據Worldpay《Global Payments Report 2026》預估，全球 BNPL 電商交易額至2030年將達5000億美元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) said on the 28th that as global buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) e‑commerce transaction volumes continue to rise, its "Big Brother Pay You Installments" service is expanding platform partnerships, moving beyond domestic e‑commerce sites such as momo and 91APP to the international cross‑border consolidation and purchasing platform Buy&Ship, further extending its payment footprint.

Wu Chien‑yi, Vice President of Telecom Finance at Taiwan Mobile, noted that BNPL is shifting from a single‑channel checkout option to a flexible payment tool usable across platforms. He projected that by 2025 the "Big Brother Pay You Installments" transaction volume will grow 64% year‑over‑year, with user numbers increasing by more than 60% annually. The integration with Buy&Ship now extends the service from domestic e‑commerce sites like momo and 91APP to cross‑border shopping.

Taiwan Mobile said that the introduction of Buy&Ship into "Big Brother Pay You Installments" gives consumers an additional installment‑payment option for cross‑border consolidation and purchasing services, allowing them to schedule large overseas shopping expenses according to their financial situation. Moreover, the motivation for cross‑border purchases is shifting from pure price considerations to overseas‑exclusive items, rare collectibles, and interest‑driven products.

The company added that from large‑scale comprehensive e‑commerce and brand‑specific sites to cross‑border shopping, it will continue embedding BNPL services into various purchasing pathways, ensuring installment payments are not limited to a single platform and expanding the range of payment scenarios available to consumers.
According to Worldpay’s Global Payments Report 2026, global BNPL e‑commerce transaction volume is projected to reach $500 billion by 2030.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金簇擁匯入 升8分收31.628元 連5周升值共7.3角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Gains as Funds Flood In, Rises 8 cents to 31.628, Up 7.3 cents Over Five Weeks
paras: 在資金持續匯入的態勢下，新台幣今(28)日全日處在升值格局，終場收在31.628元，升值8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值16.8億美元，已連續升值5周，累計升值7.3角。
新台幣今日以31.69元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.57元，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元強勁升值近0.7%，新台幣收升0.25%，星元和人民幣升值0.05%上下，日元貶值約0.15%，泰銖貶0.2%。
法人分析，市場持續關注聯準會貨幣政策和美債殖利率走向，目前台股透過良性輪動，展現多頭的高度韌性。
美國最新公布的經濟數據有，7月耐久財訂單月增率由 0.5%上升至 1.1%、大幅優於市場預期 0.5%，顯示投資力道強，不過，7月 PCE 年增率3.7%意外持平，反映通膨降溫情形停滯，因此，市場等待聯準會主席華許將於央行年會發表的演說內容，密切牽動股匯市變動。
paras_en: Amid continued inflows of capital, the New Taiwan dollar was in an appreciation pattern throughout the day on the 28th, closing at 31.628 per US dollar, up 8 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms recorded a turnover of US$1.68 billion, marking the fifth consecutive week of appreciation and a cumulative gain of 7.3 cents.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.69, up 1.8 cents, and peaked at 31.57 during the session, with a daily high‑low spread of 1.2 cents.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged about 0.7%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each gained roughly 0.05%, the Japanese yen weakened by about 0.15%, and the Thai baht fell 0.2%.

Analysts note that the market remains focused on the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy and U.S. Treasury yield trends. Meanwhile, Taiwan’s equity market is showing strong resilience through healthy sector rotation, reflecting bullish sentiment.

The latest U.S. economic data showed July durable goods orders rising month‑over‑month from 0.5% to 1.1%, far beating the 0.5% forecast and indicating robust investment demand. However, July’s PCE price index year‑over‑year held steady at 3.7%, suggesting that inflation cooling has stalled. Consequently, markets are awaiting remarks from Fed Chair Jerome Powell at the central bank’s annual meeting, which could heavily influence equities and currency movements.

paras_en: Wall Street: Fed’s Warsh says a lot yet says nothing? Fed refuses to give direction, market fears bigger volatility. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the Jackson Hole central bank meeting on Friday (the 28th), reiterating the 2% inflation target and stating that if prices do not fall quickly enough, the Fed “still has work to do.” Wall Street largely read the remarks as hawkish but also believes Warsh is deliberately leaving policy space for September, restoring some anti‑inflation credibility without committing to a rate hike.

Marvell (MRVL-US) saw its stock plunge more than 10% as the market’s appetite for AI deals waned, wiping out $21.8 billion in market value. Although the latest earnings report and revenue outlook were solid, they failed to meet the market’s lofty expectations for the AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will meaningfully contribute to revenue. The stock fell 10.28% on Friday (the 28th) to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market cap and bringing the total down to about $189.96 billion.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) set a 10‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, indicating that concerns about AI software are gradually fading. The stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting the strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings and the improving sentiment toward the software sector as peers and competitors report impressive results.

Warsh wants the market to ignore Fed commentary? Treasury reaction goes the opposite way. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh hopes bond investors will trade based on the fundamentals of the U.S. economy rather than dancing to central‑bank remarks, but market behavior so far has been the reverse. Since Warsh took office in May, the three largest single‑day moves in the Treasury yield curve have all occurred after he appeared publicly.

Forecast markets see Anthropic challenging SpaceX for the largest IPO of 2026. SpaceX’s IPO this year raised $85.7 billion, nearly three times the previous historical high. However, that crown may soon change. According to the latest data from prediction markets, AI startup Anthropic is poised to claim the title of the biggest IPO this year. Trading data from platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket show investors believe Anthropic is very likely to surpass SpaceX.

items.title: 微軟創今年最長連漲紀錄 AI軟體疑慮逐漸消退
items.title_en: Microsoft Sets Record for Longest Winning Streak This Year as AI Software Concerns Fade
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)股價創下10個月來最長連漲紀錄，凸顯隨著軟體產業證明自己並未在AI時代遭到淘汰，投資人對微軟的青睞程度大幅回升。
微軟股價過去一個月上漲30%，除了反映市場對公司7月財報的強勁正面反應，也顯示隨著同業及競爭對手公布亮眼業績，市場對軟體產業的情緒有所改善。
根據道瓊市場數據，微軟股價周五(28日)連續第六個交易日上漲，這段期間累計上漲6.7%，創下2025年10月28日以來最長的連漲紀錄。
D.A. Davidson分析師認為，Anthropic宣布擴大與Salesforce(CRM-US)的合作、並將其命名為「Claudeforce」，也為微軟股價帶來光環效應。
他表示，這項合作讓投資人意識到，「微軟在提供編排與工具框架方面，甚至比Salesforce處於更有利的位置」，這兩者都是將AI模型整合至現有企業技術架構的方式。
Luria在先前一份報告中寫道，「編排層」指的是「協調不同AI模型、部署AI代理及管理工作流程」，而微軟的Copilot AI助理在這方面表現良好。至於「工具框架」，則是指「讓AI模型能夠存取非AI軟體與功能」的過程，使AI代理能夠執行任務。
Luria表示，微軟如今已扭轉了今年稍早困擾其股價的負面論述。公司在最近一次財報中公布Azure雲端運算業務成長加速，並釋放支出可能放緩的訊號，有助於打消市場對其AI布局無法帶來投資報酬的看法。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟近期股價表現受到投資人信心增強的支持，市場越來越相信微軟能夠透過雲端以外的業務實現AI商業化，例如Copilot及GitHub程式碼助理。
他也指出，Google Cloud與亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services)強勁的營收成長，進一步證明企業雲端市場整體需求依然健康。CoreWeave與Nebius等新型雲端服務商公布的業績也傳達了類似訊息。
Lee表示，這些業績都進一步支持了微軟所說的，「客戶對AI與雲端服務的需求持續超過可用容量。」「簡單來說，整個AI基礎設施的需求持續超越可用供給。」
微軟股價周五收漲1.68%，至每股513.53美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Microsoft (MSFT-US) has set a ten‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, highlighting that as the software industry proves it has not been displaced in the AI era, investor favorability toward Microsoft has surged.

Microsoft’s stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting not only the market’s strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings but also an improvement in sentiment toward the software sector as peers and rivals report impressive results.

According to Dow Jones market data, Microsoft’s share price rose for the sixth consecutive trading day on Friday the 28th, gaining a cumulative 6.7% during that stretch, the longest winning streak since October 28, 2025.
D.A. Davidson analyst notes that Anthropic’s announcement of an expanded partnership with Salesforce (CRM‑US), branded “Claudeforce,” also adds a halo effect to Microsoft’s stock.

He said the collaboration makes investors realize that “Microsoft is in an even more advantageous position than Salesforce when it comes to providing orchestration and tooling frameworks,” both of which are ways to integrate AI models into existing enterprise technology stacks.

Luria previously wrote that the “orchestration layer” refers to “coordinating different AI models, deploying AI agents, and managing workflows,” and Microsoft’s Copilot AI assistant performs well in this area. The “tooling framework” refers to “enabling AI models to access non‑AI software and functions,” allowing AI agents to execute tasks.

Luria added that Microsoft has now turned around the negative narrative that weighed on its stock earlier this year. In its latest earnings report, the company disclosed accelerated growth in its Azure cloud business and signaled that spending may be slowing, helping to dispel market doubts that its AI strategy cannot deliver returns.

StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft’s recent stock performance is supported by growing investor confidence, as the market increasingly believes Microsoft can commercialize AI beyond the cloud, such as through Copilot and the GitHub code assistant.

He also pointed out that strong revenue growth at Google Cloud and Amazon Web Services further proves that overall demand in the enterprise cloud market remains healthy. Results from newer cloud providers like CoreWeave and Nebius convey a similar message.

Lee said these results further back Microsoft’s claim that “customer demand for AI and cloud services continues to exceed available capacity.” In simple terms, “the overall demand for AI infrastructure keeps outpacing supply.”
Microsoft’s stock closed Friday up 1.68% at $513.53 per share.

items.title: 伊朗最高領袖聲明：擴大國內生產 降低對美元依賴
items.title_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Declares: Expand Domestic Production and Reduce Dollar Dependence
paras: 伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 週五 (28 日) 呼籲政府擴大國內生產，逐步降低美元在經濟中的重要性，並將「抵抗經濟」政策列為施政核心，以因應通膨、失業與物價管理等相互交織的經濟問題。
穆吉塔巴在伊朗「政府週」發表書面聲明指出，解決當前經濟困境的關鍵，在於進一步依靠國內生產。政府除了推動經濟成長，也應擴大投資，並將資金導向有用且必要的產業，以帶動生產活動。
這項聲明發布之際，伊朗里亞爾本週在自由市場跌破 1 美元兌 200 萬里亞爾，創下歷史新低。美國近期再度加強制裁，進一步對伊朗經濟形成壓力。
穆吉塔巴表示，確保民生必需品與專業性商品供應仍有其必要；若國內產能不足，政府可以進口補充，但必須採取適當且審慎的方式。他認為，鼓勵國內生產並妥善管理進口、物價與商品服務市場，有助逐步改善伊朗經濟中的問題。
他同時要求政府加快採用伊朗年輕菁英提出的技術與創新成果，將其運用於農業、工業、通訊及教育等領域。透過改善管理、擴大專業人士與科技人才參與，以及開發新的產業潛力，可望推動伊朗經濟進一步成長與發展。
穆吉塔巴也肯定政府在戰爭期間維持民生物資與基本服務供應、修復重要受損設施及管理能源供應的表現。伊朗目前面臨制裁與封鎖加劇，使國內物流與物資調度更加困難。
國際油價週五 (28 日) 震盪收低，單週跌幅明顯，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 釋出偏鷹訊號，加上市場期待伊朗與斡旋方就恢復荷姆茲海峽通航取得進展，促使中東戰事推升的地緣政治風險溢價持續回落。
穆吉塔巴迄今尚未公開露面
伊朗前最高領袖哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 6 個月前在美國與以色列空襲中喪生，其子穆吉塔巴受傷後接任至今，卻從未公開露面或親自發聲，引發外界對其健康狀況及伊朗是否存在權力真空的疑慮。
伊朗官員及高階消息人士表示，穆吉塔巴仍在養傷，並因擔心遭刺殺而轉居幕後，但仍定期會見政府高層、接收重要報告，並對重大國家議題作出最終決定，日常權力則交由少數核心人士處理。
不過，他不僅缺席父親 7 月的葬禮活動，至今也沒有發布任何照片、影片或音訊，僅透過主播宣讀少數書面聲明。
穆吉塔巴長期隱身已動搖民眾信心。
華府中東研究所研究員Alex Vatanka 指出，問題已從他是否仍然在世，轉變為伊朗是否還有一位實際運作的最高領袖；就連支持政權的強硬派人士也要求看到他仍在領導國家的證明，反對派與改革派則進一步質疑，他是否仍活著並參與決策。
paras_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Friday (the 28th) called on the government to expand domestic production, gradually reduce the dollar's importance in the economy, and make the "resistance economy" policy a core of governance to address intertwined issues of inflation, unemployment and price management.

In a written statement released during Iran's "Government Week," Mojtaba said the key to solving the current economic hardship lies in further relying on domestic production. In addition to promoting economic growth, the government should expand investment and channel funds toward useful and necessary industries to spur production activity.

The statement comes as the Iranian rial fell below 2 million rials per US dollar in the free market this week, hitting a historic low. Recent U.S. sanctions have intensified pressure on Iran's economy.

Mojtaba stressed that ensuring the supply of essential consumer goods and specialized products remains necessary; if domestic capacity falls short, the government may import to fill gaps, but must do so in an appropriate and prudent manner. He believes encouraging domestic output while carefully managing imports, prices and the goods‑services market will gradually improve Iran's economic problems.

He also urged the government to accelerate the adoption of technologies and innovations proposed by Iran's young elite, applying them to agriculture, industry, communications and education. By improving management, expanding the participation of professionals and tech talent, and developing new industrial potential, Iran’s economy can achieve further growth and development.

Mojtaba praised the government's performance during the war in maintaining the supply of civilian goods and basic services, repairing severely damaged infrastructure, and managing energy supplies. Iran now faces heightened sanctions and blockades, making domestic logistics and material coordination increasingly difficult.

International oil prices slipped lower on Friday (the 28th), with a noticeable weekly decline. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled a more hawkish stance, and markets are hopeful of progress between Iran and mediators on reopening the Hormuz Strait, causing the geopolitical risk premium from the Middle‑East conflict to continue receding.
Mojtaba has not yet appeared publicly.

Six months ago, Iran's former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed in U.S. and Israeli airstrikes; his son Mojtaba, injured in the attack, succeeded him but has never made a public appearance or spoken in person, raising external doubts about his health and whether a power vacuum exists in Iran.

Iranian officials and senior sources say Mojtaba is still recuperating and, fearing assassination, has moved behind the scenes, yet he regularly meets senior government officials, receives key reports, and makes final decisions on major national issues, while day‑to‑day authority is handled by a small core group.
However, he missed his father's July funeral ceremonies and to date has not released any photos, video or audio, communicating only through a few written statements read by broadcasters.
Mojtaba's long‑term invisibility has eroded public confidence.

Alex Vatanka, a researcher at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, noted that the question has shifted from whether he is still alive to whether Iran still has a functioning supreme leader; even hard‑line supporters of the regime demand proof that he is still leading the country, while opposition and reformists further question whether he is alive and participating in decision‑making.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強本周漲約1% 華許演講提高9月升息預期
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 28th) to near a two‑week high after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first thematic speech at the Jackson Hole conference, leading the market to view his stance as hawkish. Warsh said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved," prompting traders to raise expectations for a September Fed rate hike.
The dollar gained roughly 1% this week, recouping the entire loss it suffered last week when a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries triggered a so‑called "currency‑devaluation trade."
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.5% to 99.65, its highest level since August 18.

The highly anticipated Jackson Hole annual economic policy symposium speech by the Fed chair covered topics ranging from artificial intelligence (AI) and forward guidance to the current economic situation. Notably, he said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved" and reiterated that the Fed must keep price stability as its policy priority.

Warsh’s speech came as the Fed was navigating a complex environment. Recent inflation data remained elevated, oil prices were pushed higher by the seemingly endless U.S.–Iran conflict, and a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report deepened divisions within the Federal Open Market Committee, with three regional Fed presidents opposing the July decision to keep rates unchanged.
In his prepared remarks, Warsh said, "As of now, I believe the labor market is at a level of full employment. But with respect to our price‑stability mandate, the current data are more concerning."

The market interpreted the speech as hawkish, and traders lifted their expectations for a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑bp hike in September is now above 57%, up from roughly 35% the day before.

Deutsche Bank analyst Matthew Luzzetti and his team said, "Chair Warsh’s speech surprised us both in the concreteness of his economic outlook and his clearly hawkish tone. After his remarks we think the pressure for a 25‑bp hike in September now rests on the data, unless upcoming releases come in far below expectations. Conversely, we still expect the Fed to raise rates by 50 bps this year, with hikes at the September and December meetings."
Currency‑devaluation trades receded and the dollar recovered.
After Warsh’s speech, U.S. Treasury yields turned higher and bonds were sold off. The 10‑year yield rose 5.9 bp to 4.729%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12 bp to 4.352%.

Bond markets have been extremely volatile lately; long‑dated Treasuries have been sold off amid inflation concerns, a large volume of corporate issuance, and the continued expansion of U.S. sovereign debt.
The U.S. Treasury’s unexpected intervention last week had limited effect in curbing the rise in yields.

Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike by raising borrowing costs for consumers and firms, which usually supports a stronger dollar. However, news that U.S. sovereign debt surpassed $40 trillion last week sparked concerns about fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies—a strategy known as a "currency‑devaluation trade."
In fact, the dollar index fell almost 1% last week while gold and cryptocurrencies rose. Both assets continued to climb this week, but their gains were modest compared with the dollar’s strength.
The Canadian dollar was hit hard by the trade dispute and fell sharply this week.
Among other major currencies, the Canadian dollar drew attention from FX traders as the trade war between Washington and Ottawa heated up, leading the loonie to drop 1%.

After negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down over the weekend, both sides imposed retaliatory tariffs on each other. U.S. President Trump pushed on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

Canadian government data released on Friday showed the economy rebounded strongly in the second quarter, growing 3.3% year‑over‑year, well above the revised 0.3% gain in the first quarter. The growth matched economists’ forecasts but far exceeded the Bank of Canada’s roughly 2.5% projection.
The yen touched 160 for the first time since the historic intervention.

Following Warsh’s hawkish speech, the yen came under pressure on Friday. USD/JPY reached 160, the first time it has hit that level since the historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. The 160 mark has previously been a trigger for intervention.

Conversely, the Korean won strengthened against the dollar for the second consecutive trading day, with USD/KRW falling about 0.5% this week. After investors digested the Bank of Korea’s decision on Thursday to raise rates for the second consecutive meeting, the won rallied and borrowing costs rose to an 18‑month high.
