items.title_en: AI Orders Remain Elusive as Marvell Crashes Over 10%, Wiping Out $21.8 Billion in Market Value
paras: Marvell (MRVL-US) 最新財報與營收展望雖然表現穩健，仍未能滿足市場對 AI 業務的高度期待。投資人尤其關注與 Google (GOOGL-US) 合作的客製化晶片業務，何時才能對營收帶來顯著貢獻，拖累 Marvell 週五 (28日) 暴跌 10.28%，收在 216.62 美元，單日市值蒸發約 217.8 億美元，降至約 1,899.6 億美元。
隨著大型科技公司競相採用客製化晶片，以降低成本並提升效能，Marvell 成為 AI 投資熱潮的主要受惠者之一，今年以來股價一度接近上漲兩倍。
然而，在大型科技公司今年 AI 支出可望突破 7,400 億美元之際，市場對相關晶片業者的業績期待也水漲船高，穩健的財報與財測已不足以支撐股價。
Marvell 雖然上調 2027 與 2028 會計年度營收預測，市場焦點卻集中在新公布的 Google 客製化晶片合作案。這項交易截至 2033 會計年度可能帶來最高 1,200 億美元營收，但投資人仍無法確定相關業務何時開始大幅挹注營收。
執行長 Matt Murphy 表示，公司截至 2028 會計年度的客製化晶片營收目標，已納入部分 Google 業務貢獻，但相關收入要到 2029 會計年度才會變得更具規模。
在資料中心業務成長帶動下，Marvell 預估 2027 會計年度營收將成長約 45%，2028 會計年度則可望達到約 180 億美元。
摩根士丹利分析師指出，市場原本抱持更高期待，主要就是受到 Google 合作案激勵；然而，這項交易的部分營收貢獻，大致已反映在公司先前提出的財測中，因此未能帶來更多新的上行空間。
Melius Research 認為，儘管上季業績與近期財測相較市場預期不算特別亮眼，但 Google 合作案、與微軟的潛在商機，以及 AI 連接業務的成長空間，仍可能推動公司在 2020 年代結束前具備每股盈餘 20 美元的獲利能力。
華爾街對 Marvell 的長期前景仍抱持期待。財報公布後，至少八家券商上調目標價。
LSEG 彙整數據顯示，分析師目標價中位數為 275 美元，較週五收盤價仍有約 27% 上漲空間。
不過，Marvell 目前本益比約為 74.2 倍，反映市場已提前計入相當程度的成長預期，也意味著公司必須交出更強勁的業績，才能支撐目前的高估值。
paras_en: Marvell (MRVL-US) posted solid earnings and revenue outlook, but it still fell short of the market’s lofty expectations for its AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will start contributing meaningfully to revenue, dragging Marvell’s shares down 10.28% on Friday the 28th to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market value and leaving the company worth about $189.96 billion.

As big‑tech firms race to adopt custom chips to cut costs and boost performance, Marvell has become one of the primary beneficiaries of the AI investment boom, with its stock having nearly doubled at one point this year.

However, with large‑tech AI spending expected to exceed $740 billion this year, expectations for chip makers have risen sharply, and even solid earnings and guidance are no longer enough to sustain the share price.

Although Marvell raised its revenue forecasts for fiscal 2027 and 2028, market attention is centered on the newly announced Google custom‑chip deal. The transaction could generate up to $120 billion in revenue through fiscal 2033, but investors still cannot tell when the business will begin to feed revenue in a material way.
CEO Matt Murphy said the company’s custom‑chip revenue target for fiscal 2028 already includes some contribution from Google, but that related income won’t become sizable until fiscal 2029.
Driven by growth in its data‑center business, Marvell expects fiscal 2027 revenue to grow about 45% and fiscal 2028 revenue to reach roughly $18 billion.

Morgan Stanley analysts noted that the market originally had higher hopes, largely spurred by the Google partnership; however, the portion of revenue from that deal is already largely reflected in the company’s prior guidance, leaving little new upside.

Melius Research believes that despite last quarter’s results and recent guidance not being especially dazzling relative to market expectations, the Google deal, potential opportunities with Microsoft, and growth in AI‑connectivity services could still enable the company to achieve $20 earnings per share by the end of the 2020s.
Wall Street remains optimistic about Marvell’s long‑term outlook, with at least eight brokerages raising their price targets after the earnings release.
LSEG data shows the median analyst price target is $275, implying roughly a 27% upside from Friday’s closing price.

Nevertheless, Marvell’s current price‑to‑earnings ratio is about 74.2×, indicating the market has already priced in a substantial amount of growth and that the company must deliver stronger results to justify its lofty valuation.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉華許傑克森霍爾首秀放鷹！9月升息風險驟升 美股翻黑、費半重挫近3.5%
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會首度發表重量級政策演說，對通膨釋出「偏鷹」訊號，帶動市場大幅提高 9 月升息押注，美股週五 (28 日) 由漲轉跌，三大指數終場全面收黑，輝達與英特爾 (INTC-US) 等晶片股走弱，那斯達克指數跌幅超過 0.5%。
不過，在本週稍早漲勢支撐下，三大指數週線仍全數收紅。道瓊累計週漲 0.53%，結束連續兩週跌勢；標普 500 上漲 0.49%，過去五週有四週收紅；那斯達克累計升幅達 0.85%。
華許於週五演說中表示，儘管今年夏季公布的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 與消費者物價指數 (CPI) 優於預期，但這些數據仍不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已出現有意義的改善。
華許強調，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝 2% 目標前進，否則 Fed 仍有「工作要做。」他還提到，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，利率仍是 Fed 實現政策使命的「主要工具」。
雖然華許並未直接表態支持 9 月升息，但市場將這番談話解讀為明顯偏鷹。芝商所 FedWatch 顯示，交易員押注 Fed 9 月升息 1 碼的機率，在演說後一度升至 57.5%，遠高於前一日的約 35%。
短債殖利率在演說後迅速跳升，2 年期美債殖利率大漲約 12 個基點至 4.35%，1 年期殖利率升至約 4.13%，3 年期殖利率則升至約 4.41%。
美元指數週五上漲約 0.5%至 99.68，但週線仍下跌約 1%。黃金則受到美元與殖利率走高雙重壓力，現貨金價重挫約 3%。
布蘭特原油週五下跌 0.43%，收每桶 89.31 美元，本週累計重挫 5.38%；西德州原油則徘徊在每桶 83 美元附近。
市場接下來將把焦點轉向 9 月 Fed 利率會議前最後一批關鍵經濟數據。由於華許淡化傳統前瞻指引，並強調依據即時經濟與市場訊號制定政策，接下來公布的就業與通膨數據，將直接左右 Fed 是否在 9 月啟動升息。
美股週五 (28 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭全數收高。Meta (META-US) 上漲 1.21%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.63%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.74%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 1.68%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 強漲 3.97%。
費城半導體族群一片血染。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 2.33%；博通 (AVGO-US) 跌 0.74%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 重挫 4.57%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 跌 0.36%。
記憶體族群跌多漲少。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.27%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 跌 0.55%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 近乎持平；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 2.06%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 跌 0.35%。
台股 ADR 漲跌不一。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 2.29%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 2.88%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 3.78%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 小漲 0.02%。
企業新聞
Marvell (MRVL-US) 週五崩跌 10.28% 至每股 216.62 美元，週跌幅超5%。這家晶片與網路設備公司第二季獲利雖優於分析師預期，但驚喜程度不足，尤其在股價今年迄今漲幅超 140% 的背景下，投資人對財報的要求明顯更高。此外，Marvell 與 Alphabet 旗下 Google 達成的認股權證協議所帶來的部分營收，也早已納入公司財測，未能進一步帶來新的上修空間。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 重摔4.57% 至每股 217.55 美元，週漲幅1.14%。英特爾 (INTC-US)與 Lumentum (LITE-US) 也跟隨 Marvell 一同走低，反映半導體與 AI 相關類股遭遇獲利了結壓力。
PayPal (PYPL-US) 暴跌 12.7% 至每股 53.66 美元，成為標普週五最差成分股。外媒引述知情人士報導，金融科技公司 Stripe 與私募股權公司 Advent International 已放棄收購 PayPal 的計畫。Stripe 與 Advent 拒絕評論，PayPal 則未回應置評要求。
Workday (WDAY-US) 勁揚5.76% 至每股 204.72 美元，成為標普最佳的個股。這家企業軟體公司第二季獲利優於市場預期，並上調財測。市場同時傳出，私募股權公司 Silver Lake 曾與 Workday 就潛在收購進行接洽，不過目前並未宣布任何交易。
Gap (GAP-US) 狂升逾 12% 至每股23.48 美元。該零售商第二季獲利優於預期，並宣布為旗下 Old Navy 品牌任命新任執行長，激勵市場買盤。
華爾街分析
Capital Economics 認為，華許此次釋出的訊息較先前記者會明顯更清楚、也更偏鷹。雖然他並未直接預告升息，但已為進一步收緊政策保留空間；若經濟持續強勁、通膨居高不下，升息時間甚至可能早於 Capital Economics 目前預估的 12 月。
Principal Asset Management 全球策略師 Seema Shah 也指出，儘管預期後續經濟數據將有所改善，但華許對通膨的強硬立場，已使 9 月升息的可能性進一步升高。
不過，TD Securities 策略師 Oscar Munoz 認為，市場可能有些反應過度。華許並未對 9 月升息做出明確承諾，最終決策仍將取決於會前公布的非農就業與通膨數據，因此升息與否仍存在相當變數。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)

items.title: 華許傑克森霍爾首秀放鷹！五大重點一次看
items.title_en: Warsh's Hawkish Debut at Jackson Hole! Five Key Takeaways at a Glance
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 週五 (28日) 在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表上任後首場主題演說，釋出迄今最明確的鷹派訊號。
華許直言，美國通膨仍明顯高於 Fed 的 2% 目標，近期物價降溫不足以證明潛在通膨已實質改善；在勞動市場穩定、經濟保持韌性，且金融環境談不上緊縮的情況下，Fed 當前首要任務仍應放在控制物價。
華許並未直接預告下一步利率行動，但明確表示，如果 Fed 無法確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」回到 2%，央行就「還有工作要做」。
這番談話被市場解讀為替進一步升息留下空間，投資人隨即提高對 9 月升息的押注。
五大重點一次看
一、通膨仍是首要任務，近期降溫不足以改變趨勢
華許首先把政策焦點鎖定在物價。以 Fed 偏好的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 衡量，美國 7 月通膨年增率仍達 3.7%，過去六個月年化增幅更達 4.1%，無論 PCE、消費者物價指數 (CPI)，或兩者的核心指標，都指向同一個結果：通膨仍高於 Fed 的 2% 目標。
華許認為，雖然今年夏季 PCE 與 CPI 數據優於預期，但還不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已經實質改善，過去兩年的抗通膨進展也僅屬有限。
進一步拆解 PCE 的 199 個組成項目，過去 12 個月有 54% 的商品與服務價格漲幅超過 3%，雖低於疫情後高峰約 77%，仍明顯高於疫情前 20 年平均的 32%；若只觀察最近六個月，也有 49% 項目的年化漲幅超過 3%。
華許重申，PCE 通膨率 2% 是 Fed「堅定且固定」(firm and fixed) 的目標。雖然目前中期通膨預期大致穩定，市場價格也顯示投資人仍相信 Fed 最終能恢復物價穩定，但聯準會必須密切關注，避免市場對央行控制物價的能力失去信心。
二、華許明確轉鷹，通膨不降就保留升息空間
在通膨仍未回到目標之際，華許進一步為未來政策行動畫出明確門檻。
他表示，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝目標前進，否則央行就「還有工作要做」。
這番說法並未直接承諾升息，也沒有提供具體時間表，但已是華許上任以來「最接近」承認 Fed 可能需要提高利率，以進一步緩解物價壓力的一次表態。
華許同時釐清，短期利率仍是 Fed 實現物價穩定與充分就業雙重使命的「主要工具」，非常規政策則應主要保留給真正的危機時期。
Fed 自去年 12 月以來一直將政策利率維持在 3.50% 至 3.75% 區間。
華許指出，在 7 月 28 至 29 日會議上，他與大多數決策官員認為，在決定是否調整政策前，應等待更多數據資料，尤其需要觀察供應鏈、投資流向及地緣政治局勢的變化。
換言之，華許這次並未為下一次會議預設結果，而是把政策條件說得更清楚：Fed 關注的不只是通膨是否下降，還包括下降的速度是否足以讓決策官員相信物價正可靠地回到 2%。
三、經濟與就業具韌性，金融環境也談不上緊縮
華許對美國實體經濟的評估明顯比對通膨樂觀。
他表示，美國經濟整體表現令人印象深刻，面對各種衝擊仍展現韌性，無論實體經濟或金融市場都保持相對強健。
勞動市場尤其穩定。目前失業率為 4.1%，不僅處於歷史低檔，過去兩年也沒有太大變化；初領失業救濟金人數的四週移動平均則接近數十年低點。華許認為，目前大致上想工作的人仍能保有或找到工作，整體勞動市場與充分就業狀態一致。
企業部門同樣保持擴張。過去四季設備與無形資產投資成長約 9%，創 2021 年以來最快增速；標普 500 指數成分企業過去一年獲利則成長逾 20%，企業利潤率也處於歷史相對高檔。
與此同時，華許並未看到現有利率對金融環境形成廣泛壓力。信用與貸款市場很少顯示政策正在明顯限制經濟活動，讓他很難把目前整體金融環境形容為「具有限制性」。
因此，在就業市場穩定、經濟活動仍然強勁的背景下，「通膨」成為 Fed 雙重使命中更需優先處理的問題。
四、淡化前瞻指引，華許要打造「更安靜的聯準會」
華許雖然更加明確表達對通膨的立場，卻仍拒絕告訴市場未來利率將往哪個方向走，這正是他希望重新塑造 Fed 政策溝通方式的一部分。
他主張，在正常經濟環境下應限制前瞻指引，Fed 不應讓市場過度依賴央行訊號判斷下一筆交易。華許認為，對未來政策決定保持透明並非目的本身，所有溝通最終都應服務於正確制定貨幣政策。
在決策方式上，華許希望 Fed 更重視即時、準確且可採取行動的資訊，而不是根據過時或單一數據點制定前瞻性政策。
他強調「趨勢」比個別數字更重要，因為 Fed 必須在高度不確定的環境中持續做出選擇。
市場訊號也是其中一環。華許認為，Fed 需要取得盡可能「未經過濾」的市場資訊，才能正確判斷經濟與金融狀況。
他的目標，是打造一個「更安靜」、溝通更有目的性的 Fed，最終仍以是否完成物價穩定與充分就業使命，作為央行公信力的真正衡量標準。
五、AI 可望提高生產力，但對經濟與貨幣政策影響仍待觀察
除了眼前的通膨問題，華許也把 AI 視為可能重塑美國長期經濟的重要力量。
AI 相關資本支出目前已成為企業投資的重要推力。華許指出，今年企業資本支出成長中，超過一半可能來自 AI 相關建設；與此同時，兩大主要 AI 實驗室的年化 token 銷售額合計已超過 1,000 億美元，較一年前增加逾 500%。
華許認為，AI 可能成為一個新的生產要素，但目前仍存在一連串未知數，包括 AI 能否帶來顯著且持續的生產力提升、何時產生效果，以及 token 使用究竟會與勞動力形成互補還是競爭。
此外，下一代 AI 模型究竟需要投入更多資本，或反過來發展出更節省資本的解決方案，以及 AI 創造的經濟利益最終會流向實驗室、晶片製造商、能源業者、雲端服務商、一般企業或消費者，都尚未明朗。
華許因此認為，AI 的影響最終不只涉及經濟成長與就業，也可能改變 Fed 未來對通膨及貨幣政策的判斷方式。
市場反應
華許的談話迅速改變市場利率定價。利率期貨市場反映，Fed 9 月升息機率約 60%，高於演說前約 40%，顯示交易員明顯提高對近期進一步收緊政策的押注。
華許放鷹壓抑科技股，美股主指週五小幅收低，2 年期美債殖利率一度升至 4.34%，創一個月高點；10 年期殖利率升至約 4.72%，30 年期殖利率則升至約 5.21%。
華爾街分析
這場演說真正重要之處，在於華許首次讓市場更清楚看見他的「政策門檻」。他並非預告 Fed 即將升息，而是在淡化前瞻指引的同時，更明確說明自己如何評估經濟與通膨，以及什麼情況下可能需要進一步調整政策。
花旗集團全球首席經濟學家 Nathan Sheets 表示，相較 7 月記者會後，市場如今對華許如何看待經濟已有更清楚的理解，這是「有意義的進展」。
Capital Economics 則認為，華許這次釋出的訊息比先前記者會「清楚且鷹派得多」。如果接下來公布的物價數據依然強勁，Fed 可能比該機構目前預估的 12 月更早升息。
不過，華許釋出鷹派訊號，並不代表 Fed 已經決定在 9 月採取行動。部分分析人士認為，他只是明確告訴市場，必要時升息仍是政策選項，實際時點仍取決於後續數據。
Fed 下一次政策會議將於 9 月 15 至 16 日舉行，在此之前還有新的就業與通膨數據出爐。若勞動市場持續穩定、通膨卻遲遲未見進一步降溫，市場對 Fed 9 月升息的預期可望進一步升高。
paras_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first major speech since taking office at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting on Friday (the 28th), issuing the clearest hawkish signal to date.

Warsh said outright that U.S. inflation remains clearly above the Fed’s 2% target, and recent price cooling is insufficient to prove that underlying inflation has materially improved; with a stable labor market, a resilient economy, and no tightening in the financial environment, the Fed’s top priority should still be price control.

Warsh did not directly preview the next rate move, but made it clear that if the Fed cannot be confident that underlying inflation is "clearly and sufficiently fast" returning to 2%, the central bank "still has work to do."
Markets read the remarks as leaving room for further rate hikes, and investors immediately raised bets on a September hike.
Five key takeaways at a glance
1. Inflation remains the top priority; recent cooling is not enough to change the trend

Warsh began by locking the policy focus on prices. Measured by the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE), U.S. July inflation year‑over‑year was still 3.7%, with a six‑month annualized increase of 4.1%; whether looking at PCE, the consumer price index (CPI), or their core measures, all point to the same result: inflation is still above the Fed’s 2% goal.

Warsh said that although this summer’s PCE and CPI data beat expectations, they are still insufficient to prove that the underlying inflation trend has materially improved, and progress over the past two years has been limited.

Breaking down the PCE’s 199 components, 54% of goods and services saw price gains above 3% over the past 12 months – lower than the post‑pandemic peak of about 77% but still well above the pre‑pandemic 20‑year average of 32%; looking at just the last six months, 49% of items posted annualized gains above 3%.

Warsh reiterated that a 2% PCE inflation rate is the Fed’s "firm and fixed" target. While medium‑term inflation expectations are broadly stable and market prices show investors still believe the Fed can ultimately restore price stability, the Fed must watch closely to avoid losing confidence in its ability to control inflation.
2. Warsh turns clearly hawkish, keeping rate‑hike space if inflation does not fall
With inflation still off target, Warsh laid out explicit thresholds for future policy action.
He said the Fed must be certain that underlying inflation is "clearly and sufficiently fast" moving toward the goal, otherwise the central bank "still has work to do."

The comment did not directly promise a hike nor give a timetable, but it was the closest Warsh has come since taking office to acknowledge that the Fed may need to raise rates further to ease price pressures.
Warsh also clarified that short‑term rates remain the Fed’s "primary tool" for achieving both price stability and full employment, while unconventional policies should be reserved for genuine crises.
The Fed has kept its policy rate in the 3.50%‑3.75% range since December last year.

Warsh noted that at the July 28‑29 meeting he and most policymakers agreed that more data are needed before deciding on any adjustment, especially on supply‑chain conditions, investment flows and geopolitical developments.

In other words, Warsh did not preset an outcome for the next meeting but made the policy conditions clearer: the Fed cares not only whether inflation is falling, but also whether the pace of decline is enough to convince policymakers that prices are reliably heading back to 2%.
3. The economy and labor market are resilient, and the financial environment is not tightening
Warsh’s assessment of the real economy is noticeably more upbeat than his view on inflation.
He said the U.S. economy overall is impressive, showing resilience to various shocks, with both the real economy and financial markets remaining relatively strong.

The labor market is especially stable. The unemployment rate sits at 4.1%, not only at a historic low but also unchanged over the past two years; the four‑week moving average of initial unemployment claims is near a multi‑decade low. Warsh believes that most people who want to work can keep or find jobs, and the labor market aligns with full‑employment conditions.

The corporate sector is also expanding. Over the past four quarters, equipment and intangible‑asset investment grew about 9%, the fastest pace since 2021; S&P 500 constituent earnings rose more than 20% over the past year, and corporate profit margins are at historically high levels.

At the same time, Warsh does not see existing rates exerting broad pressure on the financial environment. Credit and loan markets show little sign that policy is noticeably constraining economic activity, making it hard for him to describe the overall financial environment as "restrictive."
Thus, against a backdrop of a stable labor market and strong economic activity, "inflation" becomes the issue that needs priority handling within the Fed’s dual mandate.
4. Scaling back forward guidance, Warsh aims to build a "quieter" Fed
Although Warsh is clearer about his stance on inflation, he still refuses to tell the market the direction of future rates, which is part of his effort to reshape how the Fed communicates policy.

He argues that in normal economic conditions forward guidance should be limited; the Fed should not let markets become overly dependent on central‑bank signals to judge the next move. Warsh believes transparency about future decisions is not an end in itself, and all communication should ultimately serve the proper formulation of monetary policy.
In terms of decision‑making, Warsh wants the Fed to rely more on real‑time, accurate, actionable information rather than on outdated or single data points when crafting forward‑looking policy.
He emphasizes that "trends" matter more than individual numbers, because the Fed must keep making choices in a highly uncertain environment.
Market signals are also part of the picture. Warsh says the Fed needs to capture the most "unfiltered" market information possible to correctly gauge economic and financial conditions.
His goal is to create a "quieter" Fed with more purposeful communication, ultimately measuring the central bank’s credibility by whether it achieves price stability and full employment.
5. AI could boost productivity, but its impact on the economy and monetary policy remains uncertain
Beyond the immediate inflation issue, Warsh also sees AI as a force that could reshape the U.S. long‑term economy.

AI‑related capital spending has already become a major driver of corporate investment. Warsh noted that more than half of this year’s corporate cap‑ex growth may stem from AI projects; at the same time, the combined annual token sales of the two leading AI labs have topped $100 billion, up more than 500% from a year ago.

Warsh believes AI could become a new factor of production, but many unknowns remain, including whether AI will deliver significant and sustained productivity gains, when those gains will materialize, and whether token usage will complement or compete with labor.

Moreover, it is unclear whether next‑generation AI models will require more capital or will instead lead to capital‑saving solutions, and who will ultimately capture the economic benefits—labs, chip makers, energy firms, cloud providers, ordinary companies, or consumers.
Warsh therefore thinks AI’s impact will eventually extend beyond growth and employment, potentially altering how the Fed assesses inflation and formulates monetary policy.
Market reaction

Warsh’s remarks quickly shifted market pricing of rates. Futures markets now show roughly a 60% probability of a September hike, up from about 40% before the speech, indicating traders have markedly increased bets on near‑term tightening.

Warsh’s hawkish tone weighed on tech stocks, U.S. major indices slipped slightly on Friday, the 2‑year Treasury yield briefly rose to 4.34%—a one‑month high; the 10‑year yield climbed to about 4.72%, and the 30‑year to roughly 5.21%.
Wall Street analysis

The real significance of the speech lies in Warsh’s first clear presentation of his "policy thresholds" to the market. He did not announce an imminent hike, but while scaling back forward guidance he made his assessment of the economy and inflation—and the conditions that could trigger further policy adjustment—much clearer.

Citi Group’s global chief economist Nathan Sheets said that compared with the July press conference, the market now has a clearer understanding of how Warsh views the economy, which is a "meaningful development."

Capital Economics said Warsh’s message this time was "clearer and more hawkish" than previous briefings. If upcoming price data remain strong, the Fed could raise rates earlier than the institution’s current December estimate.

However, Warsh’s hawkish signal does not mean the Fed has already decided to act in September. Some analysts think he simply told the market that a rate hike remains an option if needed, with the actual timing still dependent on future data.

The Fed’s next policy meeting is scheduled for September 15‑16, with new employment and inflation data due before then. If the labor market stays stable while inflation continues to resist further cooling, expectations for a September hike could rise further.

items.title: 美國救日元原來是在救自己？貝森特揭背後盤算
items.title_en: Was the U.S. Really Saving the Yen to Save Itself? Bessent Reveals the Hidden Motive
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)為上月罕見出手支撐日元辯護，表示日元若出現失序波動，可能迫使投資人解除部位、衝擊全球金融市場，最終推高美國利率及家庭與企業的借貸成本。
貝森特在8月27日回覆民主黨參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)的信函中指出，日本是美債主要持有國，日元市場劇烈震盪可能引發強制平倉，進而造成全球市場動盪。他周五(28日)在社群平台X公開這封信。
美國財政部7月底與日本聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首次採取此類行動。市場觀察人士認為，貝森特之所以罕見介入匯市，除了支撐日元，也可能是為了防止日本出售美債籌措干預資金，導致美債殖利率進一步攀升。日本目前是美國公債最大的海外持有國。
貝森特沒有透露美國此次投入的具體金額，僅表示財政部動用外匯穩定基金(ESF)既有的外幣資產買進日元。他本月初曾透露，財政部在行動中使用歐元。日本財務省周五公布，政府過去一個月共投入創紀錄的964億美元支撐日元。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫先前要求貝森特說明，財政部動用ESF干預日元的分析依據及法律基礎。
貝森特回應，財政部完全遵循ESF相關法規，法律明確授權財政部長在總統批准後進行外匯交易，以維持有秩序的匯率安排。他並強調，美國並未向日本提供信貸，「日本不欠財政部任何款項，因此也不存在日本無法償還債務的風險，因為這筆債務根本不存在。」
儘管美日聯手干預一度推升日元，相關漲幅目前已部分回吐。日元周五再次跌破1美元兌160日元，為兩國協調干預當日以來首見，顯示日元貶值壓力仍未消退。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended his rare intervention last month to support the yen, warning that a disorderly yen decline could force investors to unwind positions, shock global financial markets, and ultimately push up U.S. interest rates as well as borrowing costs for households and businesses.

In a letter to Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren dated August 27, Bessent noted that Japan is a major holder of U.S. Treasury debt and that severe yen market turbulence could trigger forced liquidations, further destabilizing global markets. He posted the letter publicly on X on Friday, the 28th.

At the end of July, the U.S. Treasury and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Market observers say Bessent’s unusual foray into the FX market was not only to prop up the yen but also to prevent Japan from selling U.S. Treasuries to raise intervention funds, which could drive Treasury yields higher. Japan remains the largest foreign holder of U.S. government bonds.

Bessent did not disclose the exact amount the United States spent, only stating that the Treasury used foreign‑currency assets from the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to purchase yen. Earlier this month he revealed that the Treasury employed euros in the operation. Japan’s Finance Ministry announced on Friday that the government had injected a record $96.4 billion over the past month to support the yen.
Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chairman Elizabeth Warren had previously asked Bessent to explain the analytical and legal basis for the Treasury’s use of the ESF to intervene in the yen market.

Bessent responded that the Treasury fully complied with ESF statutes, which clearly authorize the Treasury Secretary, after presidential approval, to conduct foreign‑exchange transactions to maintain an orderly exchange‑rate arrangement. He emphasized that the United States has not extended any credit to Japan, saying, “Japan owes the Treasury nothing, so there is no risk of Japan being unable to repay debt because that debt simply does not exist.”

Although the joint U.S.–Japan intervention briefly lifted the yen, the gains have since been partially erased. The yen fell below ¥160 per dollar again on Friday – the first drop since the coordinated intervention – indicating that downward pressure on the currency remains.

paras_en: Wall Street: Fed’s Warsh says a lot yet says nothing? Fed refuses to give direction, market fears bigger volatility. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the Jackson Hole central bank meeting on Friday (the 28th), reiterating the 2% inflation target and stating that if prices do not fall quickly enough, the Fed “still has work to do.” Wall Street largely read the remarks as hawkish but also believes Warsh is deliberately leaving policy space for September, restoring some anti‑inflation credibility without committing to a rate hike.

Marvell (MRVL-US) saw its stock plunge more than 10% as the market’s appetite for AI deals waned, wiping out $21.8 billion in market value. Although the latest earnings report and revenue outlook were solid, they failed to meet the market’s lofty expectations for the AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will meaningfully contribute to revenue. The stock fell 10.28% on Friday (the 28th) to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market cap and bringing the total down to about $189.96 billion.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) set a 10‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, indicating that concerns about AI software are gradually fading. The stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting the strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings and the improving sentiment toward the software sector as peers and competitors report impressive results.

Warsh wants the market to ignore Fed commentary? Treasury reaction goes the opposite way. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh hopes bond investors will trade based on the fundamentals of the U.S. economy rather than dancing to central‑bank remarks, but market behavior so far has been the reverse. Since Warsh took office in May, the three largest single‑day moves in the Treasury yield curve have all occurred after he appeared publicly.

Forecast markets see Anthropic challenging SpaceX for the largest IPO of 2026. SpaceX’s IPO this year raised $85.7 billion, nearly three times the previous historical high. However, that crown may soon change. According to the latest data from prediction markets, AI startup Anthropic is poised to claim the title of the biggest IPO this year. Trading data from platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket show investors believe Anthropic is very likely to surpass SpaceX.

items.title: 中國駭客攻破Fed、NASA？美司法部緊急修正說法
items.title_en: Chinese Hackers Target Fed, NASA? US Justice Department Quickly Revises Statement
paras: 美國司法部週五 (28日) 修正日前公布的中國駭客案資訊，表示聯準會 (Fed)、美國國家航空暨太空總署 (NASA) 及聯邦參議院等機構，是中國國家支持駭客組織 QTFY 的攻擊目標，但不代表全部都已遭成功入侵。
司法部8月26日發布的新聞稿，原將上述政府機構列為駭客行動的「受害者」；最新版本則改稱這些機構是QTFY的「目標」。司法部解釋，原稿把所有機構都描述為受害者，但政府為查封相關網域提交的宣誓書顯示，所有機構都曾遭鎖定，實際遭入侵的只有部分單位。
這項修正縮小了已確認遭攻破的範圍。美方先前將QTFY描述為一個長期從事網路間諜活動的中國駭客組織，攻擊對象包括美國政府機構、國防承包商及其他敏感單位。
NASA及參議院攻擊未成功
根據聯邦調查局 (FBI) 隨案公布的宣誓書，QTFY至少自2018年起，便鎖定NASA、聯準會、能源部、司法部、衛生與公共服務部、國家衛生研究院 (NIH) 及聯邦參議院等政府網路。
FBI調查發現，駭客曾嘗試利用軟體漏洞入侵NASA，但NASA已完成相關程式修補，因此攻擊並未成功。
FBI、國家安全局 (NSA) 及美國網路司令部網路國家任務部隊另行發布的聯合資安公告顯示，駭客2026年3月也曾試圖進入聯邦參議院及一家美國醫院的網路，同樣未能得逞。
能源部實驗室等單位確認遭入侵
宣誓書同時列出已成功入侵的案例。美方指控，QTFY於2024年9月侵入三座美國能源部國家實驗室、NIH、衛生與公共服務部轄下機構，以及一家美國資安設備製造商，文件並將這些單位列為受害者。
聯合資安公告也指出，駭客2024年5月曾成功從未具名的國防承包商、金融機構及大學竊取資料。
截至週五，FBI及美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局 (CISA) 尚未回覆置評要求。
中國駐美大使館也未立即回應最新修正。針對美方日前公布的指控，中國使館發言人曾表示，美國利用網路安全問題抹黑中國，並反對美方擴大解釋國家安全概念，以此對中國企業採取歧視性限制。
paras_en: The US Department of Justice on Friday (the 28th) revised information it had previously released about a Chinese hacking case, stating that the Federal Reserve (Fed), the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) and the US Senate were among the targets of the China‑state‑backed hacking group QTFY, but this does not mean all of them were successfully breached.

In the press release issued on August 26, the Justice Department originally listed those government agencies as “victims” of the hacking campaign; the updated version now calls them QTFY’s “targets.” The department explained that the original draft described every agency as a victim, but the sworn affidavits submitted to seize the related domains show that while all agencies were locked onto, only some were actually infiltrated.

The amendment narrows the scope of confirmed successful intrusions. The US had previously described QTFY as a long‑standing Chinese hacker group engaged in cyber espionage, whose targets include US government bodies, defense contractors and other sensitive entities.
NASA and Senate attacks failed

According to sworn affidavits released by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) with the case, QTFY has been targeting NASA, the Fed, the Department of Energy, the Justice Department, the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the US Senate since at least 2018.
FBI investigators found that the hackers attempted to exploit software vulnerabilities to breach NASA, but NASA had already patched the relevant code, so the attack was unsuccessful.

Joint cybersecurity alerts issued by the FBI, the National Security Agency (NSA) and the US Cyber Command’s National Mission Force indicate that the hackers also tried to infiltrate the US Senate and a US hospital’s networks in March 2026, again without success.
Energy‑department labs and other units confirmed they were breached

The affidavits also list the cases that were successfully compromised. US officials allege that QTFY infiltrated three Department of Energy national laboratories, NIH, an agency under the Department of Health and Human Services, and a US cybersecurity‑equipment manufacturer in September 2024, naming those entities as victims.
The joint cybersecurity notice further states that in May 2024 the hackers successfully stole data from an unnamed defense contractor, a financial institution and a university.
As of Friday, the FBI and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) have not responded to requests for comment.

The Chinese embassy in the United States has not immediately responded to the latest revision. Regarding the accusations the US released earlier, a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy said the United States is using cybersecurity issues to smear China and opposes Washington’s broadened interpretation of national‑security concepts to impose discriminatory restrictions on Chinese companies.

items.title: 全球7月粗鋼產量年減0.3%亞洲走弱、歐美逆勢成長
items.title_en: Global July crude steel production down 0.3% year‑on‑year, Asia weakens, Europe and US grow against trend
paras: 2026年08月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 球鋼鐵產量維持低檔。世界鋼鐵協會(World Steel Association)數據顯示，2026年7月納入統計的70個國家及地區粗鋼產量為1.492億噸，年減0.3%，其中亞洲及大洋洲產量下滑，歐盟與北美則呈現成長。
亞洲及大洋洲7月粗鋼產量為1.094億噸，年減1.2%，是拖累全球產量的主要地區。
相較之下，歐美鋼鐵生產回升。歐盟27國粗鋼產量達1,050萬噸，年增3.8%；北美產量為960萬噸，年增4.9%，增幅高於其他主要地區。
從區域表現來看，7月全球粗鋼供給呈現「亞洲減產、歐美增產」格局。在全球總產量年減0.3%的情況下，歐美產量回升仍不足以完全抵銷亞洲產量下滑。

paras_en: August 29, 2026 (You Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – Global steel production remains low. Data from the World Steel Association shows that in July 2026, crude steel production in the 70 countries and regions covered was 149.2 million tonnes, down 0.3% year‑on‑year, with production in Asia and Oceania falling, while the EU and North America posted growth.
Asia and Oceania's crude steel output in July was 109.4 million tonnes, down 1.2% year‑on‑year, making it the main region dragging down global production.

In contrast, steel production in Europe and the US rebounded. The EU27 produced 10.5 million tonnes of crude steel, up 3.8% year‑on‑year; North America produced 9.6 million tonnes, up 4.9%, a higher increase than other major regions.

From a regional perspective, July's global crude steel supply showed a pattern of “Asia reduction, Europe and US increase.” While total global output fell 0.3% year‑on‑year, the rebound in Europe and the US was still insufficient to fully offset the decline in Asia.

items.title: 微軟創今年最長連漲紀錄 AI軟體疑慮逐漸消退
items.title_en: Microsoft Sets Record for Longest Winning Streak This Year as AI Software Concerns Fade
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)股價創下10個月來最長連漲紀錄，凸顯隨著軟體產業證明自己並未在AI時代遭到淘汰，投資人對微軟的青睞程度大幅回升。
微軟股價過去一個月上漲30%，除了反映市場對公司7月財報的強勁正面反應，也顯示隨著同業及競爭對手公布亮眼業績，市場對軟體產業的情緒有所改善。
根據道瓊市場數據，微軟股價周五(28日)連續第六個交易日上漲，這段期間累計上漲6.7%，創下2025年10月28日以來最長的連漲紀錄。
D.A. Davidson分析師認為，Anthropic宣布擴大與Salesforce(CRM-US)的合作、並將其命名為「Claudeforce」，也為微軟股價帶來光環效應。
他表示，這項合作讓投資人意識到，「微軟在提供編排與工具框架方面，甚至比Salesforce處於更有利的位置」，這兩者都是將AI模型整合至現有企業技術架構的方式。
Luria在先前一份報告中寫道，「編排層」指的是「協調不同AI模型、部署AI代理及管理工作流程」，而微軟的Copilot AI助理在這方面表現良好。至於「工具框架」，則是指「讓AI模型能夠存取非AI軟體與功能」的過程，使AI代理能夠執行任務。
Luria表示，微軟如今已扭轉了今年稍早困擾其股價的負面論述。公司在最近一次財報中公布Azure雲端運算業務成長加速，並釋放支出可能放緩的訊號，有助於打消市場對其AI布局無法帶來投資報酬的看法。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee表示，微軟近期股價表現受到投資人信心增強的支持，市場越來越相信微軟能夠透過雲端以外的業務實現AI商業化，例如Copilot及GitHub程式碼助理。
他也指出，Google Cloud與亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services)強勁的營收成長，進一步證明企業雲端市場整體需求依然健康。CoreWeave與Nebius等新型雲端服務商公布的業績也傳達了類似訊息。
Lee表示，這些業績都進一步支持了微軟所說的，「客戶對AI與雲端服務的需求持續超過可用容量。」「簡單來說，整個AI基礎設施的需求持續超越可用供給。」
微軟股價周五收漲1.68%，至每股513.53美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Microsoft (MSFT-US) has set a ten‑month record for the longest consecutive rally, highlighting that as the software industry proves it has not been displaced in the AI era, investor favorability toward Microsoft has surged.

Microsoft’s stock has risen 30% over the past month, reflecting not only the market’s strong positive reaction to the company’s July earnings but also an improvement in sentiment toward the software sector as peers and rivals report impressive results.

According to Dow Jones market data, Microsoft’s share price rose for the sixth consecutive trading day on Friday the 28th, gaining a cumulative 6.7% during that stretch, the longest winning streak since October 28, 2025.
D.A. Davidson analyst notes that Anthropic’s announcement of an expanded partnership with Salesforce (CRM‑US), branded “Claudeforce,” also adds a halo effect to Microsoft’s stock.

He said the collaboration makes investors realize that “Microsoft is in an even more advantageous position than Salesforce when it comes to providing orchestration and tooling frameworks,” both of which are ways to integrate AI models into existing enterprise technology stacks.

Luria previously wrote that the “orchestration layer” refers to “coordinating different AI models, deploying AI agents, and managing workflows,” and Microsoft’s Copilot AI assistant performs well in this area. The “tooling framework” refers to “enabling AI models to access non‑AI software and functions,” allowing AI agents to execute tasks.

Luria added that Microsoft has now turned around the negative narrative that weighed on its stock earlier this year. In its latest earnings report, the company disclosed accelerated growth in its Azure cloud business and signaled that spending may be slowing, helping to dispel market doubts that its AI strategy cannot deliver returns.

StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said Microsoft’s recent stock performance is supported by growing investor confidence, as the market increasingly believes Microsoft can commercialize AI beyond the cloud, such as through Copilot and the GitHub code assistant.

He also pointed out that strong revenue growth at Google Cloud and Amazon Web Services further proves that overall demand in the enterprise cloud market remains healthy. Results from newer cloud providers like CoreWeave and Nebius convey a similar message.

Lee said these results further back Microsoft’s claim that “customer demand for AI and cloud services continues to exceed available capacity.” In simple terms, “the overall demand for AI infrastructure keeps outpacing supply.”
Microsoft’s stock closed Friday up 1.68% at $513.53 per share.

items.title: 伊朗最高領袖聲明：擴大國內生產 降低對美元依賴
items.title_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Declares: Expand Domestic Production and Reduce Dollar Dependence
paras: 伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 週五 (28 日) 呼籲政府擴大國內生產，逐步降低美元在經濟中的重要性，並將「抵抗經濟」政策列為施政核心，以因應通膨、失業與物價管理等相互交織的經濟問題。
穆吉塔巴在伊朗「政府週」發表書面聲明指出，解決當前經濟困境的關鍵，在於進一步依靠國內生產。政府除了推動經濟成長，也應擴大投資，並將資金導向有用且必要的產業，以帶動生產活動。
這項聲明發布之際，伊朗里亞爾本週在自由市場跌破 1 美元兌 200 萬里亞爾，創下歷史新低。美國近期再度加強制裁，進一步對伊朗經濟形成壓力。
穆吉塔巴表示，確保民生必需品與專業性商品供應仍有其必要；若國內產能不足，政府可以進口補充，但必須採取適當且審慎的方式。他認為，鼓勵國內生產並妥善管理進口、物價與商品服務市場，有助逐步改善伊朗經濟中的問題。
他同時要求政府加快採用伊朗年輕菁英提出的技術與創新成果，將其運用於農業、工業、通訊及教育等領域。透過改善管理、擴大專業人士與科技人才參與，以及開發新的產業潛力，可望推動伊朗經濟進一步成長與發展。
穆吉塔巴也肯定政府在戰爭期間維持民生物資與基本服務供應、修復重要受損設施及管理能源供應的表現。伊朗目前面臨制裁與封鎖加劇，使國內物流與物資調度更加困難。
國際油價週五 (28 日) 震盪收低，單週跌幅明顯，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 釋出偏鷹訊號，加上市場期待伊朗與斡旋方就恢復荷姆茲海峽通航取得進展，促使中東戰事推升的地緣政治風險溢價持續回落。
穆吉塔巴迄今尚未公開露面
伊朗前最高領袖哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 6 個月前在美國與以色列空襲中喪生，其子穆吉塔巴受傷後接任至今，卻從未公開露面或親自發聲，引發外界對其健康狀況及伊朗是否存在權力真空的疑慮。
伊朗官員及高階消息人士表示，穆吉塔巴仍在養傷，並因擔心遭刺殺而轉居幕後，但仍定期會見政府高層、接收重要報告，並對重大國家議題作出最終決定，日常權力則交由少數核心人士處理。
不過，他不僅缺席父親 7 月的葬禮活動，至今也沒有發布任何照片、影片或音訊，僅透過主播宣讀少數書面聲明。
穆吉塔巴長期隱身已動搖民眾信心。
華府中東研究所研究員Alex Vatanka 指出，問題已從他是否仍然在世，轉變為伊朗是否還有一位實際運作的最高領袖；就連支持政權的強硬派人士也要求看到他仍在領導國家的證明，反對派與改革派則進一步質疑，他是否仍活著並參與決策。
paras_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Friday (the 28th) called on the government to expand domestic production, gradually reduce the dollar's importance in the economy, and make the "resistance economy" policy a core of governance to address intertwined issues of inflation, unemployment and price management.

In a written statement released during Iran's "Government Week," Mojtaba said the key to solving the current economic hardship lies in further relying on domestic production. In addition to promoting economic growth, the government should expand investment and channel funds toward useful and necessary industries to spur production activity.

The statement comes as the Iranian rial fell below 2 million rials per US dollar in the free market this week, hitting a historic low. Recent U.S. sanctions have intensified pressure on Iran's economy.

Mojtaba stressed that ensuring the supply of essential consumer goods and specialized products remains necessary; if domestic capacity falls short, the government may import to fill gaps, but must do so in an appropriate and prudent manner. He believes encouraging domestic output while carefully managing imports, prices and the goods‑services market will gradually improve Iran's economic problems.

He also urged the government to accelerate the adoption of technologies and innovations proposed by Iran's young elite, applying them to agriculture, industry, communications and education. By improving management, expanding the participation of professionals and tech talent, and developing new industrial potential, Iran’s economy can achieve further growth and development.

Mojtaba praised the government's performance during the war in maintaining the supply of civilian goods and basic services, repairing severely damaged infrastructure, and managing energy supplies. Iran now faces heightened sanctions and blockades, making domestic logistics and material coordination increasingly difficult.

International oil prices slipped lower on Friday (the 28th), with a noticeable weekly decline. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled a more hawkish stance, and markets are hopeful of progress between Iran and mediators on reopening the Hormuz Strait, causing the geopolitical risk premium from the Middle‑East conflict to continue receding.
Mojtaba has not yet appeared publicly.

Six months ago, Iran's former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed in U.S. and Israeli airstrikes; his son Mojtaba, injured in the attack, succeeded him but has never made a public appearance or spoken in person, raising external doubts about his health and whether a power vacuum exists in Iran.

Iranian officials and senior sources say Mojtaba is still recuperating and, fearing assassination, has moved behind the scenes, yet he regularly meets senior government officials, receives key reports, and makes final decisions on major national issues, while day‑to‑day authority is handled by a small core group.
However, he missed his father's July funeral ceremonies and to date has not released any photos, video or audio, communicating only through a few written statements read by broadcasters.
Mojtaba's long‑term invisibility has eroded public confidence.

Alex Vatanka, a researcher at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, noted that the question has shifted from whether he is still alive to whether Iran still has a functioning supreme leader; even hard‑line supporters of the regime demand proof that he is still leading the country, while opposition and reformists further question whether he is alive and participating in decision‑making.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強本周漲約1% 華許演講提高9月升息預期
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 28th) to near a two‑week high after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first thematic speech at the Jackson Hole conference, leading the market to view his stance as hawkish. Warsh said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved," prompting traders to raise expectations for a September Fed rate hike.
The dollar gained roughly 1% this week, recouping the entire loss it suffered last week when a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries triggered a so‑called "currency‑devaluation trade."
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.5% to 99.65, its highest level since August 18.

The highly anticipated Jackson Hole annual economic policy symposium speech by the Fed chair covered topics ranging from artificial intelligence (AI) and forward guidance to the current economic situation. Notably, he said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved" and reiterated that the Fed must keep price stability as its policy priority.

Warsh’s speech came as the Fed was navigating a complex environment. Recent inflation data remained elevated, oil prices were pushed higher by the seemingly endless U.S.–Iran conflict, and a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report deepened divisions within the Federal Open Market Committee, with three regional Fed presidents opposing the July decision to keep rates unchanged.
In his prepared remarks, Warsh said, "As of now, I believe the labor market is at a level of full employment. But with respect to our price‑stability mandate, the current data are more concerning."

The market interpreted the speech as hawkish, and traders lifted their expectations for a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑bp hike in September is now above 57%, up from roughly 35% the day before.

Deutsche Bank analyst Matthew Luzzetti and his team said, "Chair Warsh’s speech surprised us both in the concreteness of his economic outlook and his clearly hawkish tone. After his remarks we think the pressure for a 25‑bp hike in September now rests on the data, unless upcoming releases come in far below expectations. Conversely, we still expect the Fed to raise rates by 50 bps this year, with hikes at the September and December meetings."
Currency‑devaluation trades receded and the dollar recovered.
After Warsh’s speech, U.S. Treasury yields turned higher and bonds were sold off. The 10‑year yield rose 5.9 bp to 4.729%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12 bp to 4.352%.

Bond markets have been extremely volatile lately; long‑dated Treasuries have been sold off amid inflation concerns, a large volume of corporate issuance, and the continued expansion of U.S. sovereign debt.
The U.S. Treasury’s unexpected intervention last week had limited effect in curbing the rise in yields.

Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike by raising borrowing costs for consumers and firms, which usually supports a stronger dollar. However, news that U.S. sovereign debt surpassed $40 trillion last week sparked concerns about fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies—a strategy known as a "currency‑devaluation trade."
In fact, the dollar index fell almost 1% last week while gold and cryptocurrencies rose. Both assets continued to climb this week, but their gains were modest compared with the dollar’s strength.
The Canadian dollar was hit hard by the trade dispute and fell sharply this week.
Among other major currencies, the Canadian dollar drew attention from FX traders as the trade war between Washington and Ottawa heated up, leading the loonie to drop 1%.

After negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down over the weekend, both sides imposed retaliatory tariffs on each other. U.S. President Trump pushed on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

Canadian government data released on Friday showed the economy rebounded strongly in the second quarter, growing 3.3% year‑over‑year, well above the revised 0.3% gain in the first quarter. The growth matched economists’ forecasts but far exceeded the Bank of Canada’s roughly 2.5% projection.
The yen touched 160 for the first time since the historic intervention.

Following Warsh’s hawkish speech, the yen came under pressure on Friday. USD/JPY reached 160, the first time it has hit that level since the historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. The 160 mark has previously been a trigger for intervention.

Conversely, the Korean won strengthened against the dollar for the second consecutive trading day, with USD/KRW falling about 0.5% this week. After investors digested the Bank of Korea’s decision on Thursday to raise rates for the second consecutive meeting, the won rallied and borrowing costs rose to an 18‑month high.

items.title: AI大單難解近渴！Marvell暴跌超10% 市值蒸發218億美元
items.title_en: AI Orders Remain Elusive as Marvell Crashes Over 10%, Wiping Out $21.8 Billion in Market Value
paras: Marvell (MRVL-US) 最新財報與營收展望雖然表現穩健，仍未能滿足市場對 AI 業務的高度期待。投資人尤其關注與 Google (GOOGL-US) 合作的客製化晶片業務，何時才能對營收帶來顯著貢獻，拖累 Marvell 週五 (28日) 暴跌 10.28%，收在 216.62 美元，單日市值蒸發約 217.8 億美元，降至約 1,899.6 億美元。
隨著大型科技公司競相採用客製化晶片，以降低成本並提升效能，Marvell 成為 AI 投資熱潮的主要受惠者之一，今年以來股價一度接近上漲兩倍。
然而，在大型科技公司今年 AI 支出可望突破 7,400 億美元之際，市場對相關晶片業者的業績期待也水漲船高，穩健的財報與財測已不足以支撐股價。
Marvell 雖然上調 2027 與 2028 會計年度營收預測，市場焦點卻集中在新公布的 Google 客製化晶片合作案。這項交易截至 2033 會計年度可能帶來最高 1,200 億美元營收，但投資人仍無法確定相關業務何時開始大幅挹注營收。
執行長 Matt Murphy 表示，公司截至 2028 會計年度的客製化晶片營收目標，已納入部分 Google 業務貢獻，但相關收入要到 2029 會計年度才會變得更具規模。
在資料中心業務成長帶動下，Marvell 預估 2027 會計年度營收將成長約 45%，2028 會計年度則可望達到約 180 億美元。
摩根士丹利分析師指出，市場原本抱持更高期待，主要就是受到 Google 合作案激勵；然而，這項交易的部分營收貢獻，大致已反映在公司先前提出的財測中，因此未能帶來更多新的上行空間。
Melius Research 認為，儘管上季業績與近期財測相較市場預期不算特別亮眼，但 Google 合作案、與微軟的潛在商機，以及 AI 連接業務的成長空間，仍可能推動公司在 2020 年代結束前具備每股盈餘 20 美元的獲利能力。
華爾街對 Marvell 的長期前景仍抱持期待。財報公布後，至少八家券商上調目標價。
LSEG 彙整數據顯示，分析師目標價中位數為 275 美元，較週五收盤價仍有約 27% 上漲空間。
不過，Marvell 目前本益比約為 74.2 倍，反映市場已提前計入相當程度的成長預期，也意味著公司必須交出更強勁的業績，才能支撐目前的高估值。
paras_en: Marvell (MRVL-US) posted solid earnings and revenue outlook, but it still fell short of the market’s lofty expectations for its AI business. Investors are especially focused on the custom chip partnership with Google (GOOGL-US) and when it will start contributing meaningfully to revenue, dragging Marvell’s shares down 10.28% on Friday the 28th to $216.62, erasing roughly $21.78 billion in market value and leaving the company worth about $189.96 billion.

As big‑tech firms race to adopt custom chips to cut costs and boost performance, Marvell has become one of the primary beneficiaries of the AI investment boom, with its stock having nearly doubled at one point this year.

However, with large‑tech AI spending expected to exceed $740 billion this year, expectations for chip makers have risen sharply, and even solid earnings and guidance are no longer enough to sustain the share price.

Although Marvell raised its revenue forecasts for fiscal 2027 and 2028, market attention is centered on the newly announced Google custom‑chip deal. The transaction could generate up to $120 billion in revenue through fiscal 2033, but investors still cannot tell when the business will begin to feed revenue in a material way.
CEO Matt Murphy said the company’s custom‑chip revenue target for fiscal 2028 already includes some contribution from Google, but that related income won’t become sizable until fiscal 2029.
Driven by growth in its data‑center business, Marvell expects fiscal 2027 revenue to grow about 45% and fiscal 2028 revenue to reach roughly $18 billion.

Morgan Stanley analysts noted that the market originally had higher hopes, largely spurred by the Google partnership; however, the portion of revenue from that deal is already largely reflected in the company’s prior guidance, leaving little new upside.

Melius Research believes that despite last quarter’s results and recent guidance not being especially dazzling relative to market expectations, the Google deal, potential opportunities with Microsoft, and growth in AI‑connectivity services could still enable the company to achieve $20 earnings per share by the end of the 2020s.
Wall Street remains optimistic about Marvell’s long‑term outlook, with at least eight brokerages raising their price targets after the earnings release.
LSEG data shows the median analyst price target is $275, implying roughly a 27% upside from Friday’s closing price.

Nevertheless, Marvell’s current price‑to‑earnings ratio is about 74.2×, indicating the market has already priced in a substantial amount of growth and that the company must deliver stronger results to justify its lofty valuation.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉華許傑克森霍爾首秀放鷹！9月升息風險驟升 美股翻黑、費半重挫近3.5%
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會首度發表重量級政策演說，對通膨釋出「偏鷹」訊號，帶動市場大幅提高 9 月升息押注，美股週五 (28 日) 由漲轉跌，三大指數終場全面收黑，輝達與英特爾 (INTC-US) 等晶片股走弱，那斯達克指數跌幅超過 0.5%。
不過，在本週稍早漲勢支撐下，三大指數週線仍全數收紅。道瓊累計週漲 0.53%，結束連續兩週跌勢；標普 500 上漲 0.49%，過去五週有四週收紅；那斯達克累計升幅達 0.85%。
華許於週五演說中表示，儘管今年夏季公布的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 與消費者物價指數 (CPI) 優於預期，但這些數據仍不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已出現有意義的改善。
華許強調，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝 2% 目標前進，否則 Fed 仍有「工作要做。」他還提到，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，利率仍是 Fed 實現政策使命的「主要工具」。
雖然華許並未直接表態支持 9 月升息，但市場將這番談話解讀為明顯偏鷹。芝商所 FedWatch 顯示，交易員押注 Fed 9 月升息 1 碼的機率，在演說後一度升至 57.5%，遠高於前一日的約 35%。
短債殖利率在演說後迅速跳升，2 年期美債殖利率大漲約 12 個基點至 4.35%，1 年期殖利率升至約 4.13%，3 年期殖利率則升至約 4.41%。
美元指數週五上漲約 0.5%至 99.68，但週線仍下跌約 1%。黃金則受到美元與殖利率走高雙重壓力，現貨金價重挫約 3%。
布蘭特原油週五下跌 0.43%，收每桶 89.31 美元，本週累計重挫 5.38%；西德州原油則徘徊在每桶 83 美元附近。
市場接下來將把焦點轉向 9 月 Fed 利率會議前最後一批關鍵經濟數據。由於華許淡化傳統前瞻指引，並強調依據即時經濟與市場訊號制定政策，接下來公布的就業與通膨數據，將直接左右 Fed 是否在 9 月啟動升息。
美股週五 (28 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭全數收高。Meta (META-US) 上漲 1.21%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.63%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.74%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 1.68%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 強漲 3.97%。
費城半導體族群一片血染。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 2.33%；博通 (AVGO-US) 跌 0.74%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 重挫 4.57%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 跌 0.36%。
記憶體族群跌多漲少。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.27%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 跌 0.55%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 近乎持平；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 2.06%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 跌 0.35%。
台股 ADR 漲跌不一。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 2.29%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 2.88%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 3.78%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 小漲 0.02%。
企業新聞
Marvell (MRVL-US) 週五崩跌 10.28% 至每股 216.62 美元，週跌幅超5%。這家晶片與網路設備公司第二季獲利雖優於分析師預期，但驚喜程度不足，尤其在股價今年迄今漲幅超 140% 的背景下，投資人對財報的要求明顯更高。此外，Marvell 與 Alphabet 旗下 Google 達成的認股權證協議所帶來的部分營收，也早已納入公司財測，未能進一步帶來新的上修空間。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 重摔4.57% 至每股 217.55 美元，週漲幅1.14%。英特爾 (INTC-US)與 Lumentum (LITE-US) 也跟隨 Marvell 一同走低，反映半導體與 AI 相關類股遭遇獲利了結壓力。
PayPal (PYPL-US) 暴跌 12.7% 至每股 53.66 美元，成為標普週五最差成分股。外媒引述知情人士報導，金融科技公司 Stripe 與私募股權公司 Advent International 已放棄收購 PayPal 的計畫。Stripe 與 Advent 拒絕評論，PayPal 則未回應置評要求。
Workday (WDAY-US) 勁揚5.76% 至每股 204.72 美元，成為標普最佳的個股。這家企業軟體公司第二季獲利優於市場預期，並上調財測。市場同時傳出，私募股權公司 Silver Lake 曾與 Workday 就潛在收購進行接洽，不過目前並未宣布任何交易。
Gap (GAP-US) 狂升逾 12% 至每股23.48 美元。該零售商第二季獲利優於預期，並宣布為旗下 Old Navy 品牌任命新任執行長，激勵市場買盤。
華爾街分析
Capital Economics 認為，華許此次釋出的訊息較先前記者會明顯更清楚、也更偏鷹。雖然他並未直接預告升息，但已為進一步收緊政策保留空間；若經濟持續強勁、通膨居高不下，升息時間甚至可能早於 Capital Economics 目前預估的 12 月。
Principal Asset Management 全球策略師 Seema Shah 也指出，儘管預期後續經濟數據將有所改善，但華許對通膨的強硬立場，已使 9 月升息的可能性進一步升高。
不過，TD Securities 策略師 Oscar Munoz 認為，市場可能有些反應過度。華許並未對 9 月升息做出明確承諾，最終決策仍將取決於會前公布的非農就業與通膨數據，因此升息與否仍存在相當變數。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強本周漲約1% 華許演講提高9月升息預期
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 28th) to near a two‑week high after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first thematic speech at the Jackson Hole conference, leading the market to view his stance as hawkish. Warsh said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved," prompting traders to raise expectations for a September Fed rate hike.
The dollar gained roughly 1% this week, recouping the entire loss it suffered last week when a sharp sell‑off in U.S. Treasuries triggered a so‑called "currency‑devaluation trade."
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.5% to 99.65, its highest level since August 18.

The highly anticipated Jackson Hole annual economic policy symposium speech by the Fed chair covered topics ranging from artificial intelligence (AI) and forward guidance to the current economic situation. Notably, he said the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not "clearly improved" and reiterated that the Fed must keep price stability as its policy priority.

Warsh’s speech came as the Fed was navigating a complex environment. Recent inflation data remained elevated, oil prices were pushed higher by the seemingly endless U.S.–Iran conflict, and a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report deepened divisions within the Federal Open Market Committee, with three regional Fed presidents opposing the July decision to keep rates unchanged.
In his prepared remarks, Warsh said, "As of now, I believe the labor market is at a level of full employment. But with respect to our price‑stability mandate, the current data are more concerning."

The market interpreted the speech as hawkish, and traders lifted their expectations for a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑bp hike in September is now above 57%, up from roughly 35% the day before.

Deutsche Bank analyst Matthew Luzzetti and his team said, "Chair Warsh’s speech surprised us both in the concreteness of his economic outlook and his clearly hawkish tone. After his remarks we think the pressure for a 25‑bp hike in September now rests on the data, unless upcoming releases come in far below expectations. Conversely, we still expect the Fed to raise rates by 50 bps this year, with hikes at the September and December meetings."
Currency‑devaluation trades receded and the dollar recovered.
After Warsh’s speech, U.S. Treasury yields turned higher and bonds were sold off. The 10‑year yield rose 5.9 bp to 4.729%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12 bp to 4.352%.

Bond markets have been extremely volatile lately; long‑dated Treasuries have been sold off amid inflation concerns, a large volume of corporate issuance, and the continued expansion of U.S. sovereign debt.
The U.S. Treasury’s unexpected intervention last week had limited effect in curbing the rise in yields.

Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike by raising borrowing costs for consumers and firms, which usually supports a stronger dollar. However, news that U.S. sovereign debt surpassed $40 trillion last week sparked concerns about fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies—a strategy known as a "currency‑devaluation trade."
In fact, the dollar index fell almost 1% last week while gold and cryptocurrencies rose. Both assets continued to climb this week, but their gains were modest compared with the dollar’s strength.
The Canadian dollar was hit hard by the trade dispute and fell sharply this week.
Among other major currencies, the Canadian dollar drew attention from FX traders as the trade war between Washington and Ottawa heated up, leading the loonie to drop 1%.

After negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down over the weekend, both sides imposed retaliatory tariffs on each other. U.S. President Trump pushed on Thursday to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

Canadian government data released on Friday showed the economy rebounded strongly in the second quarter, growing 3.3% year‑over‑year, well above the revised 0.3% gain in the first quarter. The growth matched economists’ forecasts but far exceeded the Bank of Canada’s roughly 2.5% projection.
The yen touched 160 for the first time since the historic intervention.

Following Warsh’s hawkish speech, the yen came under pressure on Friday. USD/JPY reached 160, the first time it has hit that level since the historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. The 160 mark has previously been a trigger for intervention.

Conversely, the Korean won strengthened against the dollar for the second consecutive trading day, with USD/KRW falling about 0.5% this week. After investors digested the Bank of Korea’s decision on Thursday to raise rates for the second consecutive meeting, the won rallied and borrowing costs rose to an 18‑month high.

items.title: 美國救日元原來是在救自己？貝森特揭背後盤算
items.title_en: Was the U.S. Really Saving the Yen to Save Itself? Bessent Reveals the Hidden Motive
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)為上月罕見出手支撐日元辯護，表示日元若出現失序波動，可能迫使投資人解除部位、衝擊全球金融市場，最終推高美國利率及家庭與企業的借貸成本。
貝森特在8月27日回覆民主黨參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)的信函中指出，日本是美債主要持有國，日元市場劇烈震盪可能引發強制平倉，進而造成全球市場動盪。他周五(28日)在社群平台X公開這封信。
美國財政部7月底與日本聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首次採取此類行動。市場觀察人士認為，貝森特之所以罕見介入匯市，除了支撐日元，也可能是為了防止日本出售美債籌措干預資金，導致美債殖利率進一步攀升。日本目前是美國公債最大的海外持有國。
貝森特沒有透露美國此次投入的具體金額，僅表示財政部動用外匯穩定基金(ESF)既有的外幣資產買進日元。他本月初曾透露，財政部在行動中使用歐元。日本財務省周五公布，政府過去一個月共投入創紀錄的964億美元支撐日元。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫先前要求貝森特說明，財政部動用ESF干預日元的分析依據及法律基礎。
貝森特回應，財政部完全遵循ESF相關法規，法律明確授權財政部長在總統批准後進行外匯交易，以維持有秩序的匯率安排。他並強調，美國並未向日本提供信貸，「日本不欠財政部任何款項，因此也不存在日本無法償還債務的風險，因為這筆債務根本不存在。」
儘管美日聯手干預一度推升日元，相關漲幅目前已部分回吐。日元周五再次跌破1美元兌160日元，為兩國協調干預當日以來首見，顯示日元貶值壓力仍未消退。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended his rare intervention last month to support the yen, warning that a disorderly yen decline could force investors to unwind positions, shock global financial markets, and ultimately push up U.S. interest rates as well as borrowing costs for households and businesses.

In a letter to Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren dated August 27, Bessent noted that Japan is a major holder of U.S. Treasury debt and that severe yen market turbulence could trigger forced liquidations, further destabilizing global markets. He posted the letter publicly on X on Friday, the 28th.

At the end of July, the U.S. Treasury and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Market observers say Bessent’s unusual foray into the FX market was not only to prop up the yen but also to prevent Japan from selling U.S. Treasuries to raise intervention funds, which could drive Treasury yields higher. Japan remains the largest foreign holder of U.S. government bonds.

Bessent did not disclose the exact amount the United States spent, only stating that the Treasury used foreign‑currency assets from the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to purchase yen. Earlier this month he revealed that the Treasury employed euros in the operation. Japan’s Finance Ministry announced on Friday that the government had injected a record $96.4 billion over the past month to support the yen.
Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chairman Elizabeth Warren had previously asked Bessent to explain the analytical and legal basis for the Treasury’s use of the ESF to intervene in the yen market.

Bessent responded that the Treasury fully complied with ESF statutes, which clearly authorize the Treasury Secretary, after presidential approval, to conduct foreign‑exchange transactions to maintain an orderly exchange‑rate arrangement. He emphasized that the United States has not extended any credit to Japan, saying, “Japan owes the Treasury nothing, so there is no risk of Japan being unable to repay debt because that debt simply does not exist.”

Although the joint U.S.–Japan intervention briefly lifted the yen, the gains have since been partially erased. The yen fell below ¥160 per dollar again on Friday – the first drop since the coordinated intervention – indicating that downward pressure on the currency remains.

items.title: 日本救日元殺紅眼！一個月狂砸近千億美元創紀錄
items.title_en: Japan Rescues Yen with Aggressive Intervention, Spending Nearly $100 Billion in One Month
paras: 日本政府過去一個月砸下15.4兆日元干預匯市，規模創單月歷史新高，試圖阻止日元跌破關鍵價位。此次行動更獲得美國罕見協助，成為兩國自1998年以來首度聯手買進日元，向押注日元貶值的投機者發出強烈警告。
日本財務省周五(28日)公布，7月30日至8月26日期間，政府共投入15兆3,993億日元，約合987億美元，支撐一度跌至40年低點的日元。若依不同匯率換算，金額約為964億至987億美元，無論以何種標準計算，都寫下日本單月匯市干預新紀錄。
日本今年4月至5月已耗資11.7兆日元穩定匯率，加上最新一波行動，今年投入的干預資金累計約達27兆日元。

美日聯手向空方示警

《彭博》根據日本央行數據推算，日本可能於7月30日投入約8.45兆日元，隔日再動用約5.3兆日元。日本這次特別選在央行利率決策前一天出手，打破過去通常等到央行決策或重要經濟數據公布後才行動的模式，試圖讓交易員措手不及。
日本財務大臣片山皋月與美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本月初證實，兩國於7月31日進行協調干預，這是自1998年以來，美日首度聯手買進日元。2011年兩國雖也曾合作，但當時是在日本發生強震後賣出日元，以壓低匯價並協助經濟復甦。
美國投入金額並未計入日本財務省公布的數據，實際規模預料較小，但象徵意義重大。貝森特先前甚至刻意讓媒體看到筆記本上的待辦事項，其中包括最多買進100億美元日元；相較之下，美國在1998年與2011年的干預規模僅約10億美元。
貝森特隨後在社群平台X發文，表態支持日本採取果斷的市場與貨幣政策措施，修正日元遭到大幅低估的情況。美日也表示，未來可運用外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制(FIMA Repo Facility)支援匯市行動，淡化日本因不便出售美債、干預「彈藥」可能受限的疑慮。

日元仍難擺脫貶值壓力

日元在干預前一度逼近1美元兌164日元，隨後於8月3日最高升至155.23日元，但目前已回落至159.6日元附近，吐回美日聯手干預以來逾半漲幅。市場認為，美日利差持續存在，加上投資人擔憂日本首相高市早苗的擴張性財政政策，使日元升勢受到限制。
SMBC日興證券資深利率與外匯策略師丸山倫斗表示，日本今年已投入約27兆日元，但美元兌日元仍徘徊在160附近，反映日元背後的貶值壓力依然強勁。不過，自美國出手後，市場認為官方干預資金幾乎沒有上限，因此投機性美元買盤已有所收斂。
日元目前已約4周未再觸及160關卡，顯示交易員仍忌憚政府再次進場。美國的參與及貝森特的表態，也引發日本央行可能在9月升息的揣測。市場接下來將密切關注聯準會(Fed)主席華許在傑克森霍爾央行年會的談話，以及下周美國就業報告，判斷美國是否真會升息，進而左右日元後續走勢。
paras_en: Japan has poured 15.4 trillion yen into the foreign‑exchange market over the past month, setting a record for a single‑month intervention as it tries to stop the yen from slipping below a key level. The move was bolstered by rare U.S. assistance, marking the first joint yen‑buying effort by the two countries since 1998 and sending a strong warning to speculators betting on yen depreciation.

The Ministry of Finance announced on Friday (the 28th) that between July 30 and August 26 the government deployed 15.3993 trillion yen, roughly $98.7 billion, to support a yen that had fallen to a 40‑year low. Depending on the exchange rate used, the amount ranges from about $96.4 billion to $98.7 billion, but any calculation sets a new Japanese record for monthly FX intervention.

Japan had already spent 11.7 trillion yen from April to May this year to stabilise the currency, and with the latest round the total intervention funding for the year now tops roughly 27 trillion yen.

U.S.–Japan Joint Warning to Bears Bloomberg, using Bank of Japan data, estimates that Japan may have spent about 8.45 trillion yen on July 30 and another 5.3 trillion yen the next day. Japan chose to act the day before the BOJ’s rate decision, breaking the usual pattern of waiting for a policy decision or major data release, aiming to catch traders off‑guard.

Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this month that the two nations coordinated an intervention on July 31, the first joint yen‑buying operation since 1998. In 2011 the two countries also cooperated, but then they sold yen after a major earthquake to push the exchange rate down and aid economic recovery.

The U.S. amount was not included in the Ministry’s figures; the actual scale is expected to be modest but symbolically important. Bessent even let the media see a notebook with a to‑do item to buy up to $10 billion worth of yen; by contrast, U.S. interventions in 1998 and 2011 were only about $1 billion each.

Bessent later posted on X, expressing support for Japan’s decisive market and monetary‑policy actions to correct what he called a severe undervaluation of the yen. The two countries also said they could use the Foreign‑and‑International‑Monetary‑Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility to back future FX moves, easing concerns that Japan’s ability to intervene might be limited by its holdings of U.S. Treasuries.

The yen still faces depreciation pressure. Before the intervention it briefly approached ¥164 per $1, rose to a high of ¥155.23 on August 3, but has since slipped back to around ¥159.6, erasing more than half of the gains made since the joint action. Markets cite persistent U.S.–Japan rate differentials and worries about Prime Minister Kishida’s expansionary fiscal stance as caps on yen upside.

SMBC Nikko Securities senior rates and FX strategist Rintaro Maruyama notes that Japan has spent about ¥27 trillion this year yet the dollar‑yen pair hovers near ¥160, reflecting continued strong depreciation pressure. However, after the U.S. step‑in, markets believe official intervention funds have effectively no ceiling, tempering speculative dollar buying.

The yen has now gone roughly four weeks without testing the ¥160 barrier, showing traders still fear another government entry. U.S. participation and Bessent’s comments have also sparked speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise rates in September. Markets will watch Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s remarks at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium and next week’s U.S. jobs report to gauge whether further U.S. rate hikes are likely, which will shape the yen’s next moves.

items.title: 日美聯手救日元失靈？干預滿月回吐漲幅再度逼近160 專家：難敵巨大利差
items.title_en: US-Japan Joint Effort to Rescue the Yen Falters? Intervention’s Gains Fade as Currency Nears 160 Again, Experts Say It Can’t Overcome Massive Interest Rate Gap
paras: 日本與美國聯手出手支撐日元約一個月後，日元從約1美元兌164日元的40年低點反彈至155.23日元，但漲勢並未持續，如今再次逼近160日元。策略師表示，這次干預成功只是放緩日元短期跌勢，幾乎沒有改變導致日元長期走弱的基本因素。
日本與其他主要經濟體之間的巨大利差，仍是拖累日元的關鍵因素，這促使投資人以低成本借入日元，再將資金投向海外高收益資產。此外，日本財政前景堪憂，以及中東衝突推升油價，也進一步加重日元壓力。
道富環球投資管理公司(State Street Investment Management)資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo說：「干預處理的是市場部位，卻沒有處理油價、美國公債殖利率或美日利差。」
他指出，下一波日元持續升值，需要借助日本銀行(央行，BOJ)的貨幣正常化政策才能取得更多助力，還要配合投資人的避險資金流向行為出現改變。
隔夜指數交換合約顯示，市場目前預期日銀9月升息的機率約82%，到10月升息已幾乎完全反映在價格中。
日銀副總裁冰見野良周四(27日)發表演說時，也沒有排除下月升息的可能性。
瑞穗銀行資深策略師Masayuki Nakajima說：「由於市場已大致反映9月升息預期，若要推動日元大幅上漲，單一次政策調整恐怕還不夠。」
他表示，投資人必須相信，日本銀行後續政策正常化的步伐將比目前預期更加陡峭，日元才可能出現更強勁的升值行情。

日美官員：必要時將持續捍衛日元

美日官員已警告投資人，當局若有需要，將持續捍衛日元。日本財務大臣片山皋月曾表示，日本將利用美國聯準會(Fed)提供的一項機制，讓日本可把美國公債作為擔保借入美元，再用這些美元買進日元。
美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也曾敦促Fed擴大這項計畫，以協助日本。根據經濟學家及市場人士分析，貝森特支持日元的主要動機，很可能是避免日元大幅貶值的衝擊蔓延至美國公債市場。
市場人士表示，如果日本當局沒有出手干預，日元可能已跌向170
因為當時市場持續加碼做空日元。
雖然干預確實放緩日元兌美元的跌勢，但日元在其他主要貨幣交叉盤的漲幅消退得更多，包括兌歐元及澳幣。
Rabobank外匯策略主管Jane Foley說：「市場顯然不相信，日本基本面足以支持目前水準以下的匯率。」
她指出，日本財務省可能希望不必再次出手干預。不過，如果9月日銀升息，干預行動可能與升息同步進行，屆時市場將提高警戒。

華許周五演說成日元下一大變數

投資人周五將密切關注Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會的演說，尋找有關Fed貨幣政策及美元兌日元後續走勢的線索。
Fed上月會議紀錄顯示，多名官員曾支持升息，且許多人表示，如果通膨未能下降，政策將有必要進一步緊縮。
在此同時，美元本周已從前一周近1%跌幅中略為回升。當時由於美國財政部宣布將加碼回購美債，美國公債遭遇大幅拋售，投資人採取所謂的「貨幣貶值交易」策略，導致美元壓力罩頂。
麥格理(Macquarie)全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「華許在傑克森霍爾發表結構性偏鷹派演講的可能性，高於發表鴿派演講。鴿派演講將與聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)投票者中值立場的轉變背道而馳，也會忽略其他央行釋放的鷹派訊號，甚至無視美國通膨居高不下且依然頑強的數據。」
針對日元，Sony金融集團資深分析師Kumiko Ishikawa表示，美日聯手干預確實有效讓美元兌日元走低，但市場仍懷疑這項措施能否長期抑制日元賣壓。只要市場仍預期Fed下一步是升息，即使兩國利差略為縮小，美元對投資人而言仍將具有吸引力。
paras_en: After Japan and the United States teamed up to support the yen for about a month, the currency rebounded from a 40‑year low of roughly ¥164 per $1 to ¥155.23, but the rally stalled and the yen is now edging back toward ¥160. Strategists say the intervention merely slowed the yen’s short‑term decline and did little to change the fundamental forces that have been weakening it over the long run.

The huge interest‑rate differential between Japan and other major economies remains the key drag on the yen, prompting investors to borrow yen cheaply and invest the proceeds in higher‑yielding overseas assets. In addition, Japan’s fiscal outlook is bleak and Middle‑East conflicts have pushed oil prices higher, further weighing on the yen.

Masahiko Loo, a senior fixed‑income strategist at State Street Investment Management, said: “The intervention dealt with market positioning, but it did not address oil prices, U.S. Treasury yields or the U.S.–Japan rate spread.”
He added that the next sustained yen appreciation would need to be backed by the Bank of Japan’s monetary‑normalisation policy and a shift in investors’ hedging‑fund flow behavior.
Overnight index swaps show the market currently assigns about an 82% probability to a BOJ rate hike in September, with a September hike already almost fully priced into October rates.
When BOJ Deputy Governor Hideo Hayakawa spoke on Thursday the 27th, he did not rule out the possibility of a rate hike next month.
Mitsubishi UFJ senior strategist Masayuki Nakajima said: “Since the market has largely priced in a September hike, a single policy move is unlikely to drive a big yen rally.”
He noted that investors must believe the BOJ’s subsequent normalisation will be steeper than currently expected for the yen to see a stronger appreciation trend.

Japanese and U.S. officials: Will Keep Defending the Yen If Needed. Japan’s finance minister Shunichi Suzuki has said Japan will use a mechanism provided by the Federal Reserve that allows Japan to pledge U.S. Treasuries as collateral to borrow dollars and then use those dollars to buy yen.

U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent has also urged the Fed to expand the programme to help Japan. Analysts think Bessent’s support for the yen is likely driven by a desire to prevent a sharp yen depreciation from spilling over into the U.S. Treasury market.
Market participants say that without the intervention the yen could have fallen toward ¥170.
Because at that time the market was continuously adding short positions on the yen.
While the intervention did slow the yen’s slide against the dollar, the yen’s gains against other major currencies eroded even more, including against the euro and the Australian dollar.
Jane Foley, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at Rabobank, said: “The market clearly does not believe Japan’s fundamentals can sustain an exchange rate below the current level.”
She added that the Finance Ministry may prefer not to intervene again, but if the BOJ hikes in September, any intervention could be timed with the hike, prompting heightened market vigilance.
Investors will watch Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium on Friday for clues about Fed policy and the future path of the dollar‑yen pair.
The Fed’s minutes from last month show several officials backed a rate hike and many said further tightening would be needed if inflation does not fall.

Meanwhile, the dollar has modestly recovered this week after a near‑1% drop the previous week when the Treasury announced an expanded buy‑back of Treasuries, triggering a sharp sell‑off and a “currency‑devaluation trade” by investors that put pressure on the dollar.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said: “The odds are higher that Warsh will deliver a structurally hawkish speech at Jackson Hole than a dovish one. A dovish speech would clash with the median stance of FOMC voters and ignore hawkish signals from other central banks, as well as stubbornly high U.S. inflation data.”

Regarding the yen, Kumiko Ishikawa, senior analyst at Sony Financial Group, said the US‑Japan joint intervention did succeed in pushing the dollar‑yen lower, but markets remain skeptical about its ability to curb yen‑selling pressure over the long term. As long as the market expects the Fed’s next move to be a rate hike, even a modest narrowing of the US‑Japan spread will keep the dollar attractive to investors.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金簇擁匯入 升8分收31.628元 連5周升值共7.3角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Gains as Funds Flood In, Rises 8 cents to 31.628, Up 7.3 cents Over Five Weeks
paras: 在資金持續匯入的態勢下，新台幣今(28)日全日處在升值格局，終場收在31.628元，升值8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值16.8億美元，已連續升值5周，累計升值7.3角。
新台幣今日以31.69元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.57元，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元強勁升值近0.7%，新台幣收升0.25%，星元和人民幣升值0.05%上下，日元貶值約0.15%，泰銖貶0.2%。
法人分析，市場持續關注聯準會貨幣政策和美債殖利率走向，目前台股透過良性輪動，展現多頭的高度韌性。
美國最新公布的經濟數據有，7月耐久財訂單月增率由 0.5%上升至 1.1%、大幅優於市場預期 0.5%，顯示投資力道強，不過，7月 PCE 年增率3.7%意外持平，反映通膨降溫情形停滯，因此，市場等待聯準會主席華許將於央行年會發表的演說內容，密切牽動股匯市變動。
paras_en: Amid continued inflows of capital, the New Taiwan dollar was in an appreciation pattern throughout the day on the 28th, closing at 31.628 per US dollar, up 8 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms recorded a turnover of US$1.68 billion, marking the fifth consecutive week of appreciation and a cumulative gain of 7.3 cents.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.69, up 1.8 cents, and peaked at 31.57 during the session, with a daily high‑low spread of 1.2 cents.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged about 0.7%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each gained roughly 0.05%, the Japanese yen weakened by about 0.15%, and the Thai baht fell 0.2%.

Analysts note that the market remains focused on the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy and U.S. Treasury yield trends. Meanwhile, Taiwan’s equity market is showing strong resilience through healthy sector rotation, reflecting bullish sentiment.

The latest U.S. economic data showed July durable goods orders rising month‑over‑month from 0.5% to 1.1%, far beating the 0.5% forecast and indicating robust investment demand. However, July’s PCE price index year‑over‑year held steady at 3.7%, suggesting that inflation cooling has stalled. Consequently, markets are awaiting remarks from Fed Chair Jerome Powell at the central bank’s annual meeting, which could heavily influence equities and currency movements.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Awaiting Waller Talk, Dollar in Narrow Range
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國7月年通貨膨脹率連續六十五個月高於美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)的2%目標，恐加劇FED內部爭論應加息還是維持利率不變，並隨著美國與伊朗衝突未解決，但交火已減少，油價和整體通貨膨脹率已從春季中期觸及的高位回落，聯邦基金利率期貨市場則預計FED在9月升息的機率約40%，令美元陷於窄幅震盪；此外，日本央行(BOJ)副總裁冰見野良三表示，日本經濟正經受中東衝突的衝擊，但燃料成本高企及全球人工智能(AI)需求導致晶片價格上漲推高通貨膨脹，日圓走軟可能導致通貨膨脹比以往更快上升，有必要及時加息，其言論進一步鞏固市場對BOJ近期加息的預期，國際貨幣市場經紀商Totan Tanshi數據則顯示，市場預估BOJ於9月加息的概率為86%，並據前日本財務省財務官篠原尚之表示，近日美國與日本協調日圓干預與以往不同，認為央行缺席削弱對市場傳遞訊效果，但稱BOJ有必要盡快將利率至少上調至1.5%，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓下滑至159.10低點。

隨後美國7月數據顯示，貿易逆差創十六個月來最大達1,188億美元，但躉售庫存增加1.3%，另外上周初請失業金人數降至20.3萬人，表明勞動力市場仍保持穩定，並據堪薩斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁施密德與克里夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克相繼表態傾向支持加息，而且市場關注FED主席沃什週五在杰克森霍爾央行年會上發表談話，推升美元兌日圓至159.52高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於158.80-159.00，阻力於159.60-80。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲四大銀行中，有三家預測澳洲央行(RBA)年內將再次加息，並據澳洲統計局數據顯示，第二季民間資本支出意外較前季減少3.6%，但7月份月度家庭支出指標(MHSI)升1.1%，家庭支出較去年同期增幅升至7%，為連續第三個月增長及2023年6月以來最高，表明民間需求保持堅挺，激勵澳幣和紐元，帶動歐元兌美元穩守1.1636低點。
隨著歐洲央行(ECB)公布7月對非金融企業與家庭貸款分別較上年同期增速為4.4%及3.1%高於前值，並據伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)調查德國8月就業指標升至94.8，為去年5月以來最高，而且7月ECB會議紀錄顯示決策者認為或需最早於9月再加息一次，提振歐元兌美元至1.1659高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1650-70，支撐於1.1570-90。
◆GBP/USD

美國通貨膨脹數據高於預期且經濟增長前景向好，強化市場對FED加息的押注，並據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)數據顯示，市場預計英國央行(BOE)要到明年2月會議才會加息25個基點，同時英國公債收益率跌勢繼續緩步下行，打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3567低點。隨著市場等待FED主席沃什在杰克森霍爾年度貨幣政策研討會發表談話，找尋貨幣政策路徑的線索，但許多分析預計其將避免就貨幣政策提供任何指引壓抑美元，推動英鎊兌美元回升至1.3602高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3590-1.3610，支撐於1.3500-20。

U.S. July annual inflation has stayed above the Fed's 2% target for 65 consecutive months, potentially intensifying internal Fed debates over whether to raise rates or hold them steady. With the U.S.-Iran conflict unresolved—though fighting has eased—oil prices and overall inflation have retreated from the mid‑spring highs. Fed funds futures show about a 40% chance of a September rate hike, leaving the dollar in a narrow range. Meanwhile, BOJ Deputy Governor Himekura Ryosuke said Japan’s economy is feeling the impact of the Middle‑East conflict, but high fuel costs and rising AI‑driven chip prices are pushing inflation up, and a weaker yen could accelerate price gains, making timely rate hikes necessary. His comments further cement market expectations of a near‑term BOJ hike; Totan Tanshi data show an 86% probability of a September BOJ increase. Former Finance Ministry official Shinohara Naoyuki noted recent U.S.–Japan coordination on yen intervention differs from the past, arguing that central‑bank absence weakens market signaling, but said the BOJ should raise rates to at least 1.5% promptly to spur yen appreciation, sending USD/JPY down to a low of 159.10.

Subsequent U.S. July data showed a trade deficit of $118.8 billion—the largest in 16 months—while inventories rose 1.3%. Initial jobless claims fell to 203,000, indicating a still‑stable labor market. Kansas Fed President Schmidt and Cleveland Fed President Harker both signaled support for a rate hike, and markets focused on Fed Chair Waller’s remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium on Friday, pushing USD/JPY up to a high of 159.52. The dollar is expected to find support around 158.80‑159.00 today, with resistance at 159.60‑159.80.
EUR/USD

Yesterday three of Australia’s four big banks forecast another RBA rate hike this year. Australian Bureau of Statistics data showed Q2 private capital expenditure unexpectedly fell 3.6% from the previous quarter, but the July Monthly Household Spending Index rose 1.1%, with household spending up 7% year‑on‑year—the third consecutive month of growth and the highest since June 2023—indicating resilient private demand, boosting the AUD and NZD and keeping EUR/USD anchored at the low of 1.1636.

With the ECB reporting July loan growth for non‑financial firms and households at 4.4% and 3.1% year‑over‑year—both above prior rates—and Ifo data showing Germany’s August employment index rising to 94.8, the highest since May 2022, ECB meeting minutes indicated policymakers may need another hike as early as September, lifting EUR/USD to a high of 1.1659. Today’s EUR/USD resistance is projected at 1.1650‑1.1670, support at 1.1570‑1.1590.
GBP/USD

U.S. inflation came in hotter than expected and growth outlook looks positive, strengthening market bets on further Fed hikes. LSEG data show the market expects the Bank of England won’t raise rates by 25 bps until its February 2025 meeting, while UK gilt yields continue a gradual decline, pulling GBP/USD down to a low of 1.3567. As markets await Fed Chair Waller’s Jackson Hole speech for clues on policy direction, many analysts expect he will avoid giving forward guidance, dampening the dollar and allowing the pound to rebound to a high of 1.3602. Today’s GBP/USD resistance is seen at 1.3590‑1.3610, support at 1.3500‑1.3520.
